title: Sr Workday Systems Analyst
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. Works on a small Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) team that is responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ERCOT’s ERP product suite, which includes Workday Human Capital Management (HCM), Workday Financial Management, Workday Adaptive Planning, Workday Prism Analytics, Cornerstone OnDemand Learning Management System (LMS), and other applications (Contract Lifecycle Management, Exiger, Blackline, SuccessFactors, DocuSign). Works on broad cross-module and cross-platform functional areas. At the P3 level, this role serves as the primary technical authority and architectural lead across the ERP product suite, drives complex cross-module and cross-platform initiatives end-to-end, owns the design integrity and operational stability of the platform, and mentors P1 and P2 analysts on the team. Responsible for partnering with business stakeholders to pursue opportunities for greater efficacy and efficiency as well as to identify and resolve system issues. Provides consultation and support to SMEs and end-users of the ERP products through analysis, development, configuration, testing, promotion through environments, and change management. JOB DUTIES Understands and applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT’s culture. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Impact extends across the ERP product suite and to multiple business functions; technical decisions made in this role set direction and standards for the broader IT ERP team. Provides day-to-day technical guidance, design review, and mentoring to P1 and P2 analysts on the team; coaches lower-level analysts through complex configuration, reporting, integration, and security work. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES Architecture and design leadership: Define and shape the overall functional and business process architecture across the ERP product suite ensuring efficient and accurate design and configuration of the delivered solution. Serve as the primary technical authority on cross-module and cross-platform design decisions, combining expert-level proficiency in Workday and senior-level proficiency in Cornerstone OnDemand with deep understanding of HR, Finance, and Learning process architecture; translate broad and ambiguous requirements into deliverables and partner with HR and Finance functional analysts to align process design across departments. Release, delivery, and change management: Lead Workday release checklist process and complex issue resolution and post-release stabilization. Partner with HR and Finance business owners on Kainos Smart Test execution; lead defect triage for cross-module and high-severity defects. Sponsor and present major and high-risk changes at Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings; review and endorse changes presented by junior analysts; serve as a primary CAB representative and ensure change management and SDLC principles are applied across the ERP product suite. Reporting and analytics: Architect and lead the design of the reporting and analytics layer across the ERP product suite, including Workday Report Writer (Advanced, Matrix, Composite, and Search reports), calculated fields, BIRT report design files (authored in Workday Studio for report layout and formatting), Workday Prism Analytics datasets and dashboards, and Cornerstone Reporting. Lead the design of complex multi-source, audit-grade, and executive-facing reports; review and approve reports built by junior analysts; prepare scheduled and ad-hoc reports; set standards for report writing, calculated field design, and data governance; provide SMEs and junior analysts with report writing guidance, instructions, and documentation. Ensure data accuracy, security, and data privacy standards are met through reviews, testing, change management, routine data audits, and validation. Workday Prism Analytics: Administer the Prism environment — dataset design, transformations, dashboards, Discovery Boards, & security to deliver advanced analytics and reporting across HR and Finance. Set standards for Prism dataset modeling, naming, and governance; review and approve Prism work performed by junior analysts; partner with HR and Finance business owners on Prism roadmap and use case prioritization. Create, maintain, and execute Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) integrations for inbound and outbound data movement across all Workday functional areas; provide expertise on EIBs built by SMEs and junior analysts. Security architecture and configuration: Define and govern the Workday and Cornerstone security model — security groups, domains, business process security policies, role-based access, and Cornerstone constraints / OU permissions — in compliance with ERCOT policies and procedures. Administer the segregation-of-duties (SoD) framework, drive SoD compliance and remediation, and approve security configuration changes at CAB; review security work performed by junior analysts. Configure and maintain Workday business processes, condition rules, and notifications across all functional areas; architect and lead complex business-process redesigns that span multiple functional areas and that touch security, integrations, and reporting. Assess and make recommendations on the feasibility of security, business process, and reporting changes and their impact on data accessibility, business processes, audit posture, and downstream systems. Audit and regulatory compliance: Ensure adherence to and provide response to audit and regulatory requirements — SOX-equivalent financial controls, NERC CIP, and internal / external audits — including SoD reviews, security audits, audit log analysis, and remediation planning. Lead Kainos Smart Audit monitoring and findings response for SoD conflicts, security group / domain permission anomalies, configuration change control, and sensitive-data access across Workday tenants; serve a primary IT-ERP audit liaison and communicate effectively with SMEs, executives and external auditors. Cornerstone LMS architecture and administration: Administer ERCOT’s Cornerstone OnDemand environment — organizational units (OUs), learning objects, curricula, certifications, dynamic learning assignments, SCORM / AICC / xAPI content loads, custom reports, and security. Serve as technical contact for Cornerstone; partner with the Learning function on roadmap and platform decisions. Production support, operations, and vendor management: Own the production support function for the ERP product suite, including triage and resolution of the most complex, cross-module, and high-severity incidents escalated from others; conduct root-cause analysis and drive corrective action. Monitor recurring processes and scheduled jobs; perform regular application, systems, and administration tasks. Own third-party vendor escalations for Workday, Cornerstone, Kainos, and other ERP products. Manage change requests, and major project tasks in Jira; review and prioritize the team’s ServiceNow ticket queue; set and maintain technical and procedural documentation standards in Confluence (runbooks, configuration notes, integration design notes, post-mortems, and architectural decision records) and govern shared files in SharePoint and OneDrive in accordance with ERCOT records-management and data-classification standards. Mentoring, standards, and cross-team engagement: Provide day-to-day thought leadership, technical mentoring, and design review for junior analysts on the team and for HR- and Finance functional analysts and testers. Establish and maintain standards, guidelines, security policies, and quality assurance procedures for the ERP product suite; contribute to technical standards review. Partner with IT (Infrastructure, Identity, Information Security, and Data) to address system, interface, data, and vendor issues; represent the ERP team in cross-IT design forums. Maintain presence in the Workday Community and Cornerstone Success Center; participate in regional user groups and conference sessions; cultivate external peer networks at other Workday customers to benchmark and share approaches. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Requires minimum 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements, including at least 3 years of hands-on Workday and/or Cornerstone OnDemand configuration, administration, or development experience, and at least 1 year of demonstrated leadership on complex cross-module or cross-platform ERP initiatives. Requires deep knowledge of Workday HCM and Workday Financial Management business processes, expert-level proficiency in Workday best practices, senior-level proficiency in Cornerstone OnDemand or another major LMS, and excellent technical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Combination of training and experience in information technology and business operations to incorporate business systems analysis, process analysis, EIB integration development, BIRT report design, security architecture, audit support, vendor oversight, and technical communication skills effectively into the role to maintain a high functioning ERP system. Preferred: experience with Workday Prism Analytics, Cornerstone LMS administration, audit support in a SOX-equivalent or NERC CIP environment, mentoring of junior analysts. EDUCATION Bachelor’s Degree: Computer Science, Business, MIS, Information Systems, Information Technology, Human Resources, Accounting, Finance, or related field (Required) or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required. Preferred: multiple Workday Pro certifications (e.g., HCM, Financials, Prism, Reporting, or Security) and / or Cornerstone OnDemand administrator training / certification. WORK LOCATION – Taylor, TX: Employees will be required to be on-site in Taylor, TX at a minimum of 2 days per week, or more, as needed based on the business needs as determined by management Remote work is required to be performed from your Texas residence. Employees may opt to work on-site more than required or 100% of the time The foregoing description reflects the minimum qualifications and the essential functions of the position that must be performed proficiently with or without reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. It is not an exhaustive list of the duties expected to be performed, and management may, at its discretion, revise or require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned. This job description is not intended to create a contract of employment with ERCOT. Both ERCOT and the employee may exercise their employment-at-will rights at any time. #LI-DN ERCOT is firmly committed to equal employment for all qualified persons without regard to race, sex, medical condition, religion, age, creed, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, ancestry, veteran status, genetic information or any other protected category under federal, state or local law. Expected Salary Range: $109,000 - $150,000

title: Project Manager Sr
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. JOB SUMMARY Manages projects in accordance with established project governance. Plans, directs and coordinates activities of assigned projects for designated IT or Business area, to ensure that goals and approved scope are accomplished within the prescribed time frame and funding parameters. Develops, manages and coordinates project plans of different degrees of complexity. Manages a detailed work breakdown, resource commitments, budget, risks, and communication for each phase of the project, as required by project governance. Partners with the project Business Owner and Technical Lead on project delivery strategy, providing focus on transparency and project controls. JOB DUTIES Understands and applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT's culture. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Impact is generally limited to specific assignments or projects. May respond to inquiries and/or provide assistance and/or guidance to lower level workers. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES Leads multiple medium/high complexity projects simultaneously, maintaining deep engagement across all workstreams and resource pools, under supervision of PMO management. Partners with the project business owner, and technical lead to determine the delivery strategy, provide direction to the project team, and drive stakeholder awareness. Provides concise executive-level communication and recommendations to sponsors, steering committees, and senior leadership. Manages complex team dynamics, effectively facilitates conflict resolution, conducts negotiations, and achieves organizational objectives through strategic influence absent formal authority, with support from PMO management. Actively engages the project team to drive delivery by facilitating decisions, resolving blockers, identifying risks, issues, and mitigation plans, and maintaining momentum across workstreams, project team members, vendors, and stakeholders. Navigates a matrixed resource environment, negotiating resource commitments with resource and project managers across competing project priorities. Manages external dependencies across teams, systems, and delivery timelines to maintain schedule integrity and risk management. Identifies and manages cross-project and cross-program dependencies that may impact scope, schedule, cost, or business outcomes. Escalates issues appropriately and facilitate timely decision-making among stakeholders when priorities or requirements conflict. Conducts deep scope analysis to develop and maintain a detailed, accurate work breakdown structure throughout the project lifecycle. Maintains a current and accurate project plan at all times, reflecting real resource assignments, actual progress, and updated forecasts. Maintains reasonable variance between cost forecasts and actuals, with timely explanations for deviations. Coordinates vendor procurement, engagement, delivery and performance in alignment with project objectives, as applicable. Partners with business stakeholders to support organizational readiness, adoption planning, and implementation activities. Maintains timesheet compliance across the project team, including reviewing and approving or rejecting weekly time submissions. Utilizes existing and emerging technologies to drive efficient and effective project operations, including collaboration and productivity tools, AI, data analysis, and PPM tooling. Operates effectively within a highly regulated, audit-conscious environment, ensuring project documentation, compliance artifacts, and reporting meet organizational and regulatory standards. Supports PMO continuous improvement initiatives, as assigned. Supports PMO sponsored projects or other initiatives, as assigned. Fosters a project culture aligned with ERCOT’s core values. EXPERIENCE Minimum 5 years related work experience managing projects, product or workstream delivery, in excess of degree requirements (Required) Experience as a project manager within a formal enterprise PMO, including structured phase-gate governance and tollgate approval processes and accountability for executive engagement. Experience managing medium/high complexity projects with cross-functional resource pools. Experience working within a matrixed organization, including resource negotiation and shared-service delivery models. Experience operating in a highly regulated, audit-conscious environment with formal documentation, compliance, and reporting requirements. Experience managing projects using traditional waterfall and hybrid methodologies within a structured phase-gate governance framework. Working experience at an ISO/RTO, ISO/RTO stakeholder, or Electric Utility environment (Preferred) Proficiency in a Project Management scheduling tool such as Microsoft Project, as well as practical experience using a project ticketing and workflow system such as JIRA. (Required) Proficiency in AI prompt design. (Preferred) Additional preferred experience depending upon the hiring team and project demands. Digital & ERP Projects - IT infrastructure projects, including data center refresh, compute and storage upgrades, network modernization, or fiber expansion Enterprise application implementations, migrations, or end-of-life system replacements Cybersecurity or compliance-driven initiatives, including security assessments, endpoint protection, or regulatory standard alignment Identity and access management (IAM) projects, including governance, provisioning, or access control implementations Enterprise data, AI, or toolchain modernization initiatives, including data governance, platform migrations, or developer tooling Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Treasury, and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) projects ERCOT ISO Operations & Regulatory Projects: Commercial operations or market systems projects, including customer registration, forward and real-time wholesale market, wholesale settlement, and retail market applications Grid system interconnection, planning, and operations projects, including forecasting, network modeling, and energy management systems and tools External stakeholder and customer platform projects, including websites and user portals EDUCATION Bachelor’s Degree: Business, Management, Engineering, IT, or related field (Required) Or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required CERTIFICATION PMP Project Management Professional (Preferred) Agile and Scrum certifications (Optional) Organizational Change Management certifications (Optional) Lean Six Sigma certifications (Optional) The foregoing description reflects the minimum qualifications and the essential functions of the position that must be performed proficiently with or without reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. It is not an exhaustive list of the duties expected to be performed, and management may, at its discretion, revise or require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned. This job description is not intended to create a contract of employment with ERCOT. Both ERCOT and the employee may exercise their employment-at-will rights at any time. ERCOT is firmly committed to equal employment for all qualified persons without regard to race, sex, medical condition, religion, age, creed, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, ancestry, veteran status, genetic information or any other protected category under federal, state or local law. Expected Salary Range: $113,000 - $156,000

title: Senior Project Manager
jd_text: You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And ─ as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” ─ is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our Culture of Care . The Excellerate Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing internal/external customer interface of large and complex Excellerate product orders, including managing change, and stewarding projects through the production system to ensure customer satisfaction. Will also be responsible for overseeing staff to ensure other Excellerate Project Managers are sufficiently performing those same tasks. The ideal candidate must be proficient in the use of a PC and Microsoft Office Suite, knowledge of Accubid and AutoCAD preferred, and have the ability to work a flexible schedule and travel. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS Education: Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management or Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical training Experience: 1 year of electrical estimating experience or Experience: 5 years of experience in the electrical trade and 1 year of electrical estimating experience Travel: 15-20% Work Schedule: This position works between the hours of 7 AM and 5 PM, Monday- Friday. However, work may be performed at any time on any day of the week to meet business needs. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Plans and manages large and/or multi-site Excellerate orders. Ensures that orders are completed profitably, in a timely manner, and according to customer expectations. Maintains compliance with company policies. Promotes a positive company culture by fostering friendly and constructive employee relations. Works with Supply Chain Team and vendors to ensure effective material coordination. Identifies and generates new business. Networks, establishes, and maintains customer relationships. Processes miscellaneous paperwork. Prepares, supports, presents as required order status and manufacturing metrics to internal and external stakeholders. Reviews quotations and sales orders to ensure accuracy. Acts as coach and developer of managerial talent; as well as skillfully selects and trains those individuals. Evaluates candidates' and managers' willingness to lead, communication and planning competencies, and ability to make decisions under pressure. Assigns team and project-leadership assignments to assess skill/ability. Spends ample time evaluating people in 'test' managerial roles. Holds managers who report to him/her accountable for managerial work. Manages the boundaries that separate units which report directly and with other parts of the business. Monitors the flow of work between his/her unit and others in the organization, asking questions, and recommending improvements. Understands and conveys functional strategies, business strategies, and corporate mission. Fosters effective cross functional collaborations to accelerate work processes. Actively participates in the planning, organizing, and staffing of integration and manufacturing projects. Ensures that projects are completed safely, productively, timely, of the highest quality and according to customer expectations. Promotes merit shop philosophy by ensuring effective, fair, and timely performance evaluations for all employees. Visits various job sites and interacts with crew and customers to ensure proper job progress and to support and encourage safe behavior. Effectively delegates to direct reports with proper control systems in place to ensure accountability and to prevent decision making bottlenecks. Provides frequent and clear feedback to direct reports, offers clear direction, and ensures direct reports are sure about their goals. Organizes direct reports into a productive team to encourage synergy. Creates a supportive environment that allows mistakes but not failure (motivates and instructs; shares positive and negative feedback in a constructive manner). Performs other related duties as required and assigned. The job description and responsibilities described are intended to provide guidelines for job expectations and the employee's ability to perform the position described. It is not intended as a comprehensive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills or abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. title: Lead Business Intelligence & AI Solutions Analyst – Single Family
jd_text: Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home. Job Description The Impact You Will Make As a Lead Associate on the Collateral Strategy & Innovation team , you will help shape the future of Fannie Mae's collateral and valuation capabilities through data, analytics, technology, and artificial intelligence. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on technical capability and can translate between business needs, data, and technology. You will contribute to strategic initiatives spanning appraisal and valuation modernization, collateral data and platforms, workflow and process improvement, and the responsible application of AI and automation. As a valued colleague on our team, you will lead complex analysis, help translate business challenges into actionable requirements and solutions, and guide the development of applications and business intelligence capabilities. You will partner across Business, Product, Technology, Analytics, Policy, and other teams to move innovative concepts from exploration through implementation. What You Will Do Lead complex analysis using structured and unstructured data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights. Apply SQL, data analysis, and visualization skills to explore data, test hypotheses, evaluate outcomes, and support decision-making. Use Python, R, or comparable analytical tools to perform analysis, automate repeatable work, prototype solutions, and evaluate new capabilities. Identify and evaluate practical applications of artificial intelligence, generative AI, machine learning, and automation to improve collateral decisioning, efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes. Develop prototypes and proofs of concept to test ideas and demonstrate business value. Translate complex business problems into clear requirements, analytical approaches, data needs, and technology capabilities. Analyze processes and systems to identify root causes, control gaps, manual work, and opportunities for simplification or automation. Partner across Product, Technology, Analytics, Policy, Operations, and other stakeholders to advance modernization initiatives from discovery through implementation. Support appraisal and valuation modernization initiatives involving collateral data, valuation platforms, property data, UAD 3.6, appraisal alternatives, and emerging capabilities. Communicate complex analytical and technical findings clearly and influence decisions across technical and non-technical audiences. Required Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. Demonstrated experience using data and analytics to solve complex business problems and develop actionable insights. Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing complex datasets. Hands-on experience with Python, R, or comparable analytical/programming tools . Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools. Experience translating business problems into analytical approaches, requirements, or technology solutions. Demonstrated ability to lead complex work and collaborate effectively across business and technical teams. Desired Experience with artificial intelligence, generative AI, machine learning, automation, or other emerging technologies. Experience developing prototypes, proofs of concept, analytical tools, or automated solutions. Experience with mortgage lending, collateral risk, appraisal, property valuation, real estate data, or housing finance. Familiarity with appraisal modernization, UAD 3.6, Collateral Underwriter®, appraisal alternatives, or related valuation technologies. Experience with process improvement, technology implementation, or evaluating data and technology capabilities. title: Senior Operations Manager
jd_text: Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year. We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own Vendor Performance Management: Run the weekly performance cadence across all fulfillment vendors: scorecard reviews, follow-ups, and corrective action plans; and hold partners accountable to SLAs with persistence and professionalism. - Manage Partner Relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of fulfillment vendors: own the recurring meeting cadence, lead business reviews, advocate for Vetcove externally, and keep relationships strong through the ups and downs of operational performance. - Analyze at Scale: Interrogate large datasets (SQL, Excel, BI tools) to identify root causes, quantify operational impact, and build the case for process and integration changes. Defend your conclusions with data. - Partner with Product & Engineering: Translate recurring operational failure modes into integration and fulfillment improvements; write clear requirements, drive prioritization, and follow through until fixes ship and the metrics move. - Operationalize New Initiatives: Take run-state ownership of newly launched programs: build the SOPs, own the KPIs, and make the operational decisions that keep them healthy at scale. - Build Operational Rigor: Author and maintain SOPs, escalation paths, and process documentation that make our vendor operations consistent, auditable, and scalable as the platform grows. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5-8 years of experience in operations, program management, marketplace/ecommerce operations, or supply chain – ideally in roles where you were accountable for external partner performance. - A documented record of relentless follow-through: you chase answers across organizations, escalate when needed, never let a thread die, and deliver on time without being reminded. - Strong analytical skills: proficiency in SQL (or demonstrated equivalent), advanced Excel/Sheets, and comfort drawing defensible conclusions from large, messy datasets. - Exceptional attention to detail: you notice the mismatched count, the silent data gap, the SLA miss buried in an average. - Experience managing vendor or partner relationships end to end; serving as a partner’s main point of contact, and balancing relationship-building with direct, constructive accountability conversations. - Excellent written communication and the ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams. - Self-directed and highly organized in a fully remote environment. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in ecommerce fulfillment, 3PL, pharmacy, or distribution operations. - Familiarity with BI/analytics tools (e.g., Hex, Looker, Tableau) and building or maintaining operational dashboards. - Background in animal health, healthcare, or another regulated fulfillment category. BENEFITS (FULL TIME ROLES) - 100% remote within the USA - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Automatic 401k contribution - Employee referral program - At home office set up - Bi-annual company retreats - Open vacation policy - Equity - Monthly team events The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $100,000/year -$150,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. For Colorado, the salary range is: $115,000 - $140,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. This salary range is a good faith estimate of what Vetcove may pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, and experience. The range reflects the base hourly rate or annual compensation (as applicable), and does not include bonus, equity or other incentives. In addition to base compensation, Vetcove offers a comprehensive benefits package. Please refer to the “Benefits (Full Time Roles)” section above for more details. To apply, please submit your application through Vetcove’s Careers Page. The application deadline is on an ongoing basis. Please note we are unable to sponsor work visas at this time. title: Senior Order to Cash Operations Manager
jd_text: ABOUT ZIP Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. YOUR ROLE As a Senior Order to Cash (OTC) Operations Manager at Zip, you will own and scale the end-to-end OTC function for recurring subscriptions and consumption revenue models. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Required - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. CPA is a plus. - 8+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, revenue accounting, or order-to-cash, including time at a high-growth technology company. - Experience managing hybrid revenue models (recurring subscription + consumption). - Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for reconciliation and data analysis. - Familiarity using Snowflake queries for data retrieval and analysis; SQL proficiency is a plus. - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. - Working knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and application to billing. - Experience building AI-driven workflows involving multiple data sources and/or multiple system integration points. - Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work while owning strategic initiatives. - Track record of building or overhauling finance processes and systems, with sound judgment on what to build now and what to defer. - Familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, and modern billing and collections tooling. title: Marketplace Operations Manager II
jd_text: Job Title: Marketplace Operations Manager II Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA About the Company Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager II to own visit delivery for a defined set of Wheel's client programs. This is an operator's role for someone who wants day-to-day ownership of critical business outcomes - and can carry that accountability even when some levers live with peer functions. You'll take on the complex, ambiguous problems that come with scaling a fast-growing telehealth marketplace - from stabilizing a roster through demand volatility, to leading cross-functional projects that shape how Marketplace Operations scales next. You will own the visit delivery SLA commitments, program-level consult cost performance, and the roster health for your clients. Separate functions on the team own overall clinician supply forecasting, clinician performance management, and scheduling - freeing you up to optimize their use within your programs. This is a role for someone who wants to run marketplace operations for key clients end-to-end: launching and configuring new client programs, writing the operational playbooks your programs run on, and deploying incentive spend within guardrails - while trusting peer functions to own adjacent responsibilities in order for you to maintain a singular, maniacal focus on client performance. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Program Performance and Delivery - Own marketplace performance outcomes (contractual and otherwise) for your assigned client programs: SLA attainment, program-level clinician pay cost, and roster/staffing health. - Own roster composition and staffing strategy for your programs, building and adjusting rosters to ensure SLA through client growth, churn, and short-term volatility. - Own operational data analytics and reporting for your programs - pulling and interrogating utilization, breach-pattern, and profitability data yourself and turning it into recommendations and actions - Own the operating rhythm and upward performance visibility for your programs: recurring performance reviews of SLA, utilization, and cost that turns into actions. - Partner with the Capacity Planner to understand near-term volatility and how it may affect client demand (ie demand surges, modality changes, etc) and own the operational response for your programs (escalation thresholds, incentive levers, roster mix) to keep the program on track. Cost and Incentives - Optimize program-level clinician pay cost and deploy consult incentive spend within a defined budget. - Own the cost plan for your programs and be accountable to variance - partner with the Director of Marketplace on expected cost-per-consult, and keep your lever costs calibrated so you know how to deploy your incentives appropriately. Real-Time Response and Agent Oversight - Author the real-time escalation and response playbook your programs run on: thresholds, approved corrective actions, escalation triggers. Real-time monitoring and AI agents execute against the playbook you write, and you refine how they act on your programs as their capabilities grow. - Review how the agents act on your programs - audit their decisions for quality, catch policy drift or mistakes early, and feed corrections back into the playbook and the agent logic. You're the human-in-the-loop that keeps automated responses trustworthy on your book. - Partner with clinician management peers to relay clinician performance observations that impact your programs and to identify roster improvements that will drive your client performance. Client Launches and Partnership - Partner with Customer Success as the operational counterpart on the client's commercial relationship - supporting quarterly business reviews and the real-world story behind client performance. - Own launch supply-readiness with Provider Operations and the Capacity Planner - ensuring clinicians are credentialed, licensed, and activated in the right states, at the volume the program needs, before go-live. - Lead new-client implementation - configuration and setup - as part of cross functional onboarding teams, and own expansions for programs you already run. - Support strategic projects across Marketplace Operations as they arise. WHO YOU ARE - An operator with experience working in fast-paced, high-demand environments - someone who digs into the details to find root cause, spots broken or inefficient processes, and builds the fix rather than just flagging the problem. - Experience owning end-to-end operational performance in a marketplace, logistics, or two-sided platform environment (delivery, rideshare, staffing, workforce management) - direct accountability for SLA, throughput, or cost. - Strategic thinker who connects day-to-day program performance to the bigger picture - you can zoom out from a single roster or escalation to spot the pattern worth fixing structurally, and zoom back in to execute it. - A strong cross-functional partner and team player - you know how to work through peer teams and different personalities to drive your program's outcomes, even when you don't own every lever yourself. - Strong data fluency. You pull and interrogate your own SLA, completion, utilization, and cost-to-plan data and drive decisions from it - hands-on with SQL, Looker, and Excel - rather than waiting for someone to translate it for you. - A direct, clear communicator who authors and revises the procedures your programs run on - escalation playbooks, response plans, launch runbooks - rather than only following ones someone else wrote. NICE TO HAVE Don't let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. - Exposure to multi-state licensure, credentialing, or other regulated-workforce dynamics. - Experience launching or configuring new client programs in a marketplace or platform business. - Healthcare, telehealth, or regulated-workforce experience. - Marketplace or platform experience. SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $122,075- $155,000 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Jr. Quality Systems Specialist
jd_text: POSITION OVERVIEW: The Jr. Quality Systems Specialist (JQSS) is responsible for assisting with the implementation and/or usage of assigned internal or external software applications. The JQSS is also responsible for the collection and distribution of data from these systems. Data collection and Exporting Intermediate knowledge of SaaS systems. Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. The incumbent will be subject to inside environmental conditions. COMPANY OVERVIEW: Join a team driven to excel in all that we do! TAS delivers innovative packaged modular systems that are engineered and manufactured in one of our Houston, TX facilities and utilized in data centers, power, and commercial/industrial utility system applications. TAS has successfully delivered and commissioned over 520 packages to over 33 countries. TAS manages all logistics and transportation facilitating accelerated construction at customer’s facilities. TAS’ fastest growing business is the data center market. By applying deep expertise in cooling, thermodynamics, and power, TAS has developed an entire product line that revolutionizes data center delivery. With our tremendous market potential, advanced technological systems, entrepreneurial culture as well as a talented and productive workforce, we continue to set and exceed aggressive market penetration and financial goals. jd_text: Job Title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience Location: Remote, USA ABOUT THE COMPANY Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting http://www.wheel.com/www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners. You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering. WHAT YOU'LL DO (JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES) Strategy & Vision - Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product - Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making - Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through - Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution - Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur - Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations - Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data - Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration Cross-Functional Leadership - Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders - Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike - Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers WHO YOU ARE (JOB QUALIFICATIONS) - 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process - Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different - Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations - Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production - Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well - Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy - A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast Skills & Competencies - Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work - Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model - Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions - Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design - Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction - Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric - High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $201,700-$301,700 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the final level determined (Staff or Principal), scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Engineer Technician II
jd_text: Job Title: Engineer Technician II Job Description: The Role: Our site in Burnet, TX is seeking an Engineering Technician II in receiving to join our team. In this role you would be responsible for starting, monitoring, and troubleshooting purification systems. Additionally, the technician will perform decontamination, sampling, filling, and inspecting products. This role will be part of a team that strives to ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety and quality while meeting the timeliness of our customer’s desire. Furthermore, the technician will work cross-functionally. Shift schedule is a 3-2-2-3 on night shift from 6pm-6am once fully trained and certified. What You’ll Do: Run purifications systems under specific quality and engineering controls Perform decontamination of manufacturing equipment Sample, fill, and inspect final products Pull chemistry samples and submit to the lab for analysis Fill different sized canisters with chemistry and package as a finished good product Perform inspection of complete product to ensure proper quality standards Perform lab maintenance including PMs, ordering supplies, cleanup, and waste disposal Ensure on-time delivery of low volume products from make to ship Propose and implement process improvements Work with Engineers to run experiments, troubleshoot systems, create/update PMs, and maintain spare parts Other duties as assigned What We Seek: Knowledge of sublimation, decon, valve building, harvesting, fill, and morph solids Good communication skills, training experience, and troubleshooting skills The ability to keep up with daily production demands Accountability to have good attendance and consistent daily performance Discipline to follow work instructions and standard operating processes A dedication to excellence by being proactive with tasks to keep processes going and a willingness to perform whatever task is needed The creativity and innovation to improve productivity, cost savings, and safety A commitment to operating safely and with the highest quality standards. Outstanding Candidates Will Have: 2+ years of experience in a technical field (chemical, semiconductor, aerospace, automotive) High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate degree in chemistry, process operations, or another technical field a plus Previous chemical handling experience Previous manufacturing experience is a plus Knowledge of inventory management; SAP experience is a plus; Working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 45000 Frequently lift up to 50lbs and push up to 130lbs Flexible, able to rapidly respond to new situations and to perform multiple tasks What We Offer: At Entegris, we invest in providing opportunity to our employees and promote from within. The new hire in this role will have the potential to grow and create relationships across the organization and be recognized for demonstrated success and adherence to company PACE values. Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs Flexible work schedule and 11 paid holidays a year Paid time off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge Education assistance to support your learning journey Values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence. At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

title: Business Intelligence & AI Solutions Analyst- Single Family
jd_text: Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home. Job Description The Impact You Will Make As an Associate on the Collateral Strategy & Innovation team, you will help modernize Fannie Mae's collateral and valuation capabilities through business intelligence, technology, automation, and artificial intelligence. We are looking for someone who brings strong problem-solving ability, technical curiosity, initiative, adaptability, and the ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies This role is ideal for someone who is curious, adaptable, and technology-oriented and enjoys using data and technology to solve business problems. You will support business intelligence, applications, reporting, automation, and process-improvement initiatives while gaining exposure to emerging technologies and evolving business needs. As a valued colleague on our team, you will collaborate with business and technical partners to understand needs, analyze information, develop insights, and help implement practical technology-enabled solutions. What You Will Do Use business intelligence and analytical tools to explore data, identify trends, and develop actionable insights. Develop and enhance dashboards, reports, business applications, and automated workflows using tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint . Explore practical applications of artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging technologies to improve processes and productivity. Gather and document business needs and support requirements, testing, and implementation of new or enhanced capabilities. Analyze processes and workflows to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and improved efficiency. Support prototypes and proofs of concept to test new ideas and technology solutions. Collaborate with Product, Technology, Risk, Policy, Operations, and other partners on cross-functional initiatives. Develop knowledge of collateral and valuation processes and apply that understanding to business intelligence and technology solutions. Qualifications Required Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop practical solutions. Experience using data, reporting, business intelligence, business applications, or technology tools to address business needs. Demonstrated technical curiosity and ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and business processes. Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills. Desired Experience with Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint , or similar BI, low-code/no-code, or workflow platforms. Experience with artificial intelligence, generative AI, automation, or emerging technologies. Experience developing dashboards, reports, applications, automated workflows, or other technology-enabled solutions. Exposure to SQL, Python, R, or other data analysis or programming tools. Financial services, mortgage, real estate, collateral, appraisal, or valuation experience is beneficial but not required . Qualifications Active Directory (AD), Active Directory (AD), Amazon Web Services (AWS), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Atlassian JIRA, Authentication Management, Backup and Recovery (Software), Business Analysis, Business Decisions, Business Insight Skills, Business Intelligence (BI), Business Intelligence Tools, Business Process Management Skills, Business Process Management Systems, Business Requirements Gathering, Calendar and Scheduling Tools, Cleaning and Transforming Data, Cloud Technology, Collaborating Cross-Functionally, Collaboration, Communicating in Technical Writing, Communicating Technical Information, Communication, Configuration Management (CM), Conflict Resolution {+ 75 more} Education: Bachelor's Level Degree (Required) The future is what you make it to be. title: Manager of Accounting & Financial Planning
jd_text: About Us: Since 1980, DynaTen Corporation (a Comfort Systems USA Company) has delivered high-quality Commercial Construction and Service Solutions across the greater North Texas market. We partner with our clients to provide technical expertise and high-level execution on every project. As a result, DynaTen is a trusted provider of HVAC, Plumbing, and Building Automation Controls solutions. Our culture is built on accountability, teamwork, and a commitment to developing our people. We take pride in promoting from within, supporting both field and office teams, and delivering results the right way. We offer strong long-term career opportunities, excellent benefits, and a positive, team-oriented work environment. Position Summary The Manager of Accounting & Financial Planning is responsible for leading the financial planning, reporting, analysis, and operational finance functions of the organization. This role partners closely with executive leadership, operations, project management, and accounting teams to drive profitability, improve financial performance, strengthen internal controls, and support strategic decision-making. This position reports to the Vice President of Finance. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial planning and forecasting processes. Analyze financial results and provide actionable recommendations to executive leadership. Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives, capital investments, and operational decisions. Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and communicate results to leadership. Partner with Operations, Project Executives, Project Managers, and Project Accountants to monitor project financial performance. Review project cost-to-complete forecasts, analyze project profitability, and identify project risks, margin erosion, or cost overruns. Oversee Work-in-Progress (WIP) reporting and revenue recognition compliance. Review and analyze Schedules of Values (SOVs), progress billings, pay applications, subcontract agreements, lien waivers, retainage, and subcontractor compliance documentation. Partner with Operations and Project Management teams to identify and mitigate commercial, contractual, and financial risk. Lead preparation of annual operating budgets, quarterly forecasts, department-level forecasts, and project-level financial forecasts. Perform variance analysis and communicate budget-to-actual results, cash flow impacts, and working capital considerations. Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial and management reports. Support month-end and year-end close, audit preparation, GAAP compliance, company accounting policies, and internal control monitoring. Coordinate internal and external audits, including financial statement audits, SOX or internal control reviews, insurance audits, and customer audits. Serve as a liaison between auditors, accounting teams, operations personnel, and executive leadership. Evaluate existing financial and operational processes and recommend improvements that strengthen compliance, reduce risk, and improve reporting integrity. Supervise and mentor Finance Analysts, Project Accountants, and other finance personnel as assigned. Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, professional development, and standardized reporting practices. Drive process efficiency through ERP optimization, reporting tools, dashboards, KPI reporting, automation, and business intelligence solutions. Other duties as assigned. R equired Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent progressive finance experience as determined by company leadership. 10+ years of progressive finance experience. 10+ years of construction industry finance or project accounting experience. Strong knowledge of construction contracts, subcontract agreements, Schedule of Values (SOV) development and management, progress billings, pay applications, lien waivers, lien rights, retainage accounting, and change order management. Strong knowledge of job costing, Work-in-Progress (WIP) reporting, percentage-of-completion revenue recognition, project profitability analysis, and construction operations finance. Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, financial reporting, audit preparation, compliance, and internal controls. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with ERP systems in a project-based environment. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, leadership, problem-solving, and executive communication skills. Ability to partner effectively with executive leadership, operations, project management, accounting, auditors, and other cross-functional stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications CMA, MBA, CPA, or equivalent professional certification. Experience in mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, or specialty contracting industries. Experience with COINS+ ERP system. Experience managing finance, project accounting, or operational finance teams. Knowledge of cash management, treasury, corporate financial planning, data analytics, project controls, and business intelligence reporting. What you can expect Exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid Employee-Only Medical Coverage. In-house and manufacturer-led training and leadership development. Long-term career growth into operations, sales, technical, and/or leadership roles. Comprehensive benefits package and employer-sponsored professional memberships. 401(k) match, PTO, holiday pay, and more. Eligibility for the annual incentive program based on role and plan terms. Working Conditions Work is performed in office, meeting, customer, and active jobsite environments. The role requires regular local travel, occasional overnight travel, schedule flexibility, extended periods using a computer, and walking jobsites while wearing required PPE. Availability outside normal business hours may be required for significant operational or customer matters. title: Procurement Business Partner Manager
jd_text: What we offer At Evonik, you’re part of a global chemical company working in many sectors that go beyond chemistry. From lipids for tomorrow’s medicines, biosurfactants for green detergents, additives for plastics recycling or membranes to help drive forward the energy transition, you’ll play an essential part in helping the world’s most essential industries succeed. Our success hinges on a diversity of ideas powered by people, not egos. Whether you’re a scientist or engineer, new to the team or established, in business, production, or anything in between – we cheer each other on. Because we believe we can do anything. Explore everything. And Be Part of Something Special! Find out more about the many benefits we offer: https://www.evonik.com/en/careers/why.html Meet the team and get to know the people behind Evonik: https://www.evonik.com/en/news/meet-the-team.html Job Summary The Procurement Business Partner (PBP) Manager serves as the key link between Indirect Procurement and assigned sites, business units, and functions. This role drives early procurement engagement, demand shaping, governance, and value creation by partnering with stakeholders to identify cost optimization opportunities, improve compliance, and support procurement strategies. The PBP Manager works closely with site leadership, Category Managers, and cross-functional teams to align procurement activities with business needs, improve sourcing effectiveness, and maximize value delivery supporting the following business lines: Interface & Polyurethane Additives, Catalysts, Coating Additives, and Crosslinkers. Key Responsibilities Business Partnering & Demand Shaping Act as the primary point of contact between Indirect Procurement and assigned sites, engaging stakeholders early to understand business needs, challenge requirements, and shape procurement demand. Stakeholder Collaboration Build strong partnerships with site leadership and cross-functional teams, including Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and Category Management, to align procurement activities with business priorities. Cost Optimization & Value Creation Partner with stakeholders to identify cost-saving opportunities, optimize demand, support value creation initiatives, and contribute to site-level cost improvement plans. Procurement Strategy Deployment Support the execution of category strategies by driving adoption of preferred suppliers, contracts, sourcing initiatives, and supplier transition activities. Procurement Governance & Compliance Promote procurement policies and processes, improve sourcing discipline, and guide stakeholders in reducing non-standard, unmanaged, or after-the-fact purchasing. Sourcing Support & Execution Coordinate business requirements, specifications, and timelines with Category Managers to ensure sourcing activities are aligned with site needs and priorities. Supplier Performance & Issue Resolution Support resolution of supplier performance concerns, availability challenges, and operational issues in partnership with Category Managers and procurement teams. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement Monitor procurement KPIs, stakeholder satisfaction, compliance, and value realization while identifying opportunities to improve procurement effectiveness and business partnership. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Procurement, or a related field. 5–8 years of experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, or a related operational role. Experience supporting Indirect Procurement within a manufacturing, industrial, chemical, pharmaceutical, or similar environment is preferred. Strong understanding of procurement processes, sourcing governance, supplier management, and contract adoption. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and site leadership. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to drive alignment and challenge requirements constructively. Ability to identify cost optimization opportunities, support procurement initiatives, and improve compliance and process effectiveness. Experience with procurement transformation, category strategy deployment, or additional language skills (Spanish, Portuguese, or German) would be considered an asset. This role requires an on-site presence four days per week and approximately 20–40% travel to support assigned sites and business stakeholders . The Evonik Group adopts an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) approach. Candidates are assessed based on their educational qualifications, experience, job competencies and potential and shall not be discriminated against on the basis of race, ethnicity, age, gender, religion, nationality, disability or sexual orientation or other classifications protected by local, state, or provincial regulations. Your Application To ensure that your application is proceeded as quickly as possible and to protect the environment, please apply online via our careers portal . Further information about Evonik as Employer can be found at www.evonik.com/en/careers.html . Please address your application to the Talent Acquisition Manager, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
