title: Project Manager, AMI
jd_text: Job Description: Founded in 1904, ESAB Corporation is a premier narrowly diversified global leader in connected fabrication technology and gas control solutions. Our rich history of innovative products, workflow solutions, and business system, ESAB Business Excellence, enables our purpose of Shaping the World We Imagine ™. We’re looking to hire a talented Project Manager based in Denton, TX. Reporting to the AMI Global Sales Director, the Project Manager is responsible for providing leadership and direction to the ESAB capital equipment project management team responsible from quote to customer acceptance. Projects include new equipment, retrofits, and customer engineered solutions across the automated cutting and welding industry. Partner and collaborate across the ESAB organization with sales, product management, manufacturing, and field service teams to exceed customer expectations for delivery and product performance. Primary Duties Determine and define project scope and objectives while leading project team efforts across new equipment (automated welding, cutting, and orbital tig) and retrofits of cutting machines from quote to customer acceptance. Collaborate with various stakeholders to ensure strategy, adjustments, and progress for a clean project delivery. Partner with finance to prepare budget based on scope of work and resource requirements. Develop and manage a detailed project schedule and work plan to ensure adequate staffing and cost. Track project costs to meet time and budget. Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the organization focused on process discipline, collaboration, and business acumen. Develop and strengthen project management process, tools, and capabilities appropriate to varied project scale and complexity. Participate in project and install planning meetings to provide guidance to the teams and ensure open communication of challenges and solutions. Other duties as assigned or may be required to support business needs. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or related field. 5-8 years of project management or related experience. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred. Ability to partner with customers with clear communications and expectations management. Proven ability to organize and complete projects according to outlined scope, budget, and timeline. Proven ability to solve problems creatively. Experience seeing projects through the full life cycle. Excellent analytical skills. Strong interpersonal skills, written and verbal communication skills and extremely resourceful. Direct people management and experience working in a matrix environment. Demonstrated program and project management experience for portfolio of complex projects up to $30M. Proficient on office equipment and computers, including, but not limited to, Word, Outlook, Project, and Excel. Working Conditions Remains in a stationary position 50% of the time and involves additional physical demands such as ascending/descending stairs, walking stooping and standing. Must wear Personal Protective Equipment ‘PPE’ when working/visiting manufacturing and plant locations. Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery including but not limited to printer, tablets, cell phones. Moves transports, puts, or removes equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.; pushes, pulls products weighing up to 200 lbs. using provided safety tools. May be exposed to varying weather during travel. Travel approximately 15-25% to support customers and manufacturing facilities.

title: Analyst/Associate, Investment Engineering (Data Solutions)
jd_text: Job Description: Dimensional's Investment Engineering department is responsible for ownership of investment data, which means managing data from acquisition through distribution, driving analysis to create information from data, and creating the information and analysis consumed by internal and external reports. Investment Engineering is a hub group touching numerous areas of the implementation of the investment process and interacting with most other departments within Dimensional . The Data Solutions team's primary responsibilities involve overseeing the incoming base-level data and the centralized management and distribution of investment data to Dimensional’s internal Portfolio Management, Trading, and Reporting systems. The Data Solutions team seeks an Analyst/Associate capable of supporting key initiatives underpinning our daily implementation process. This role will work within the team to analyze the quality of investment data within Dimensional, including security reference, prices, ratings, and all other data crucial to the investment process. They will be a subject matter expert in the team’s existing data products and work to design new products. Success in this role will mean delivering clean, accurate data to internal as well as external clients in a timely manner, being creative at finding different ways to analyze and present relevant investment data and enhancing operational efficiencies at Dimensional to deliver value-added investment solutions to our clients. Responsibilities: Support Dimensional's investment processes by ensuring tools and systems are built with appropriate business logic. Compile, cleanse, and manage large data sets from multiple sources to support investment systems. Research and evaluate vendor data to assess quality and recommend optimal consumption patterns. Conduct data analysis using SQL Server, Snowflake, and other structured/ unstructured database technologies. Partner with Portfolio Management, Trading, Compliance to address portfolio construction questions and perform related analysis. Collaborate with internal clients to gather and define requirements for core business systems, and then design, build, and test data pipelines in partnership with data engineer resources. Assist in shaping data architecture for internal distribution of investment data, including defining and building data structures for end-user consumption. Drive efficiency through automation, process design, and implementation. Mentor and provide guidance to junior analysts, fostering skill development and knowledge-sharing across the team. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Master’s degree and/or professional certifications (e.g. CFA) preferred. 3-5+ years of experience working with large investment datasets, performing quantitative analysis, and leveraging SQL, Python, or similar data management tools. Strongly preferred: experience working with financial data sets and vendor platforms (Bloomberg, Factset, Refinitiv, Morningstar, etc.). Demonstrated interest and passion for financial markets. Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, writing business requirements, and communicating effectively with software engineers. Self-starter with proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills. Attention to detail with the ability to connect findings to broader objectives and goals. Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas and bridge investment professionals and engineering teams. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. #LI-Onsite Dimensional offers a variety of programs to help take care of you, your family, and your career, including comprehensive benefits, educational initiatives, and special celebrations of our history, culture, and growth. title: Senior Sales Operations & Compensation Manager
jd_text: ABOUT US Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less. THE OPPORTUNITY — (REMOTE - USA / CANADA) We are looking for a Senior Sales Operations & Compensation Manager to serve as the embedded operational partner to our Sales organization. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, you'll own the Salesforce data layer, forecasting cadences, compensation administration, and deal desk processes that power Wrapbook's go-to-market engine across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. This is a high-autonomy role where your work directly impacts revenue predictability — you'll be the person Sales leadership leans on to turn data into accountability, process into pipeline, and comp plans into performance. WHAT YOU'LL DO Salesforce Data Ownership & Hygiene - Own the Salesforce data layer for Sales: object model accuracy, field definitions, pipeline data integrity, and the hygiene processes that keep opportunity data trustworthy. - Build and maintain SFDC reports for Sales — pipeline views, stage conversion, rep activity, attainment — serving as the primary Salesforce reporting resource for Sales leadership and frontline managers. - Define and enforce data entry standards across the Sales org; build the accountability loops (process, tooling, or workflow) that sustain hygiene over time without manual correction. - Partner with the GTM Systems Architect on SFDC configuration changes, flow updates, and object model evolution driven by Sales process needs. - Serve as the Sales-side data partner to the GTM Insights & Analytics Manager, ensuring Salesforce objects and fields are correctly structured as upstream inputs to Snowflake and the BI layer. Forecasting & Pipeline Cadences - Own the Sales forecast process operationally: run the weekly pipeline and forecast review cadence, partner with frontline managers to validate SFDC data (deals, close dates, eGPV, stage accuracy), and ensure action items are followed through. - Prepare pipeline review materials — pulling from SFDC reports — that surface trends, risks, slippage, and coverage gaps by segment for Sales leadership discussion. - Proactively flag forecast risks and data quality issues; escalate coverage shortfalls and drive cross-functional conversations when pipeline generation is off track. - Partner with the GTM Insights & Analytics Manager on forecast accuracy improvement: they bring the BI modeling and historical analysis; you bring the SFDC data discipline and process accountability. - Support GTM MBR and QBR cadences with consistent, SFDC-sourced reporting inputs and segment-level operational narrative. Sales Compensation Design & Administration - Own end-to-end compensation administration for the Sales organization — plan documents, quota assignments, attainment tracking, payout calculations, approval processes and dispute resolution. - Partner with the Head of Revenue Operations and Finance to support annual comp plan design, ensuring plans are aligned to GTM strategy, bookings goals, and crediting rules for both standard and non-standard deal structures. - Maintain the compensation administration platform as the system of record, ensuring calculation accuracy, auditability, and clean data lineage from deal close to payout. - Manage the full comp calendar — plan communication, quota letter distribution, mid-year adjustments, and commission statement delivery. - Administer SPIFs and accelerators; track performance and report outcomes to Sales leadership and Finance. - Build and maintain comp infrastructure that scales with headcount growth and plan complexity — modular, documented, and auditable. Sales Process & Deal Desk Operations - Own the documentation and operationalization of Sales processes and methodology — ensuring consistent execution from prospecting through close. - Partner with Sales leadership and Enablement to drive process adoption and accountability, with clear feedback loops on where breakdowns occur in the funnel. - Own the deal desk process for standard and non-standard pricing: define the approval matrix, set and enforce SLAs, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure contract and implementation handoffs execute without friction. - Identify process gaps and prioritize improvements in partnership with the GTM Systems Architect; translate Sales business requirements into system changes. - Optimize the Marketing → Sales → Implementation → Customer Success handoff, reducing friction at each transition point. Operating Cadences & GTM Rhythm - Own the weekly pipeline and forecast review end-to-end: preparation, facilitation, and follow-through. - Track open headcount and hiring progress across the Sales org; flag capacity and coverage risks to RevOps and Sales leadership. - Partner with Sales leadership on bookings planning — coordinating inputs from segment leads, validating against historical data, and stress-testing plan assumptions. - Support segment performance reviews by preparing SFDC-sourced operational inputs; partner with GTM Insights for the analytical narrative layer. WHAT YOU'LL HAVE We're looking for a Salesforce-native Sales operator who combines system precision with process ownership — someone whose SFDC data is clean enough to trust, whose comp statements arrive on time and without errors, and whose forecast reviews actually improve rep behavior. Core Experience & Mindset - 5–8 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations in a B2B SaaS environment. - Deep Salesforce ownership experience — object model design, data hygiene management, and SFDC as the system of record for Sales. - Direct experience owning sales compensation administration — plan design support, attainment tracking, payout calculation, and dispute management. - Proven ability to own a forecasting cadence: running the process, driving data discipline in CRM, and delivering reliable roll-ups to leadership. - Comfortable building and maintaining SFDC reports and dashboards for Sales leadership and frontline managers. - Working knowledge of how Salesforce data flows into downstream systems — sufficient to partner effectively with Analytics Engineering and GTM Insights without owning those layers. Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent) is a plus. - High ownership orientation — identifies what needs to be done and does it without being directed. - Strong cross-functional communicator: fluent in a forecast review with a sales manager and a comp dispute conversation with Finance in the same week. - Comfortable in a fast-moving, build-mode environment with limited process inheritance. Salesforce & Technical Fluency - Advanced Salesforce experience — object model design, reporting, dashboards, pipeline management, data hygiene, Flows. - Salesforce Administrator Certification (Plat-Admn-201) — strongly preferred. - Familiarity with how SFDC data is modeled in Snowflake/dbt as downstream inputs — sufficient to collaborate with the GTM Insights Manager and Analytics Engineering. - Comfort working across adjacent tools: comp administration tools, spreadsheet modeling, and BI platforms (Omni/Looker) as a consumer or contributor. - Familiarity with compensation administration platforms — or demonstrated ability to manage comp with high accuracy in a structured non-tool environment. WHY JOIN US At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product. In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you'll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include: - Unlimited Paid Time Off - Work from anywhere in Canada and USA - Health and Dental benefits - Up to $1500 towards IT set up for your home - Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K - Learning and Development opportunities - Up to $50 USD / $66.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service OUR PLEDGE TO FOSTERING AN INCLUSIVE AND SAFE WORKPLACE Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation. APPLY NOW Have we got your attention? Submit your application today and a member of our Talent team will be in touch with you shortly! #LI-Remote

title: Principal Architect – Data Platforms & Architecture SME
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!</p> <p>At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Principal Architect - Data Platforms &amp; Architecture (SME)</strong></span></p> <p>The Principal Architect in Delivery leads architecture for large Azure programs that span applications,&nbsp;<br>platforms, and data. You connect business goals to cloud modernization roadmaps, define architecture&nbsp;<br>frameworks, and guide multi-team execution.</p> <p>At this level, you act as an organization-wide technical leader. You set technical direction across practices,&nbsp;<br>orchestrate cross-team discovery, keep designs aligned across multiple teams, and turn successful patterns&nbsp;<br>into reusable models. You promote strong engineering, automation, and AI-assisted practices, mentor Senior Architects and Delivery Architects, and help build an inclusive, continuously improving engineering culture while supporting clear investment and modernization decisions for 3Cloud and our clients.</p> <p>Responsibilities:</p> <p>Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership<br>• Lead architecture and technical strategy for large Azure programs and portfolios so solutions meet client goals for value, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.&nbsp;<br>• Define modernization blueprints and reference architectures across applications, platforms, and data, including system and subsystem designs, patterns, and standards that simplify delivery and operations over time.&nbsp;<br>• Translate business and product strategy into cloud architecture roadmaps and execution plans that drive measurable outcomes and adapt based on production feedback and telemetry.&nbsp;<br>• Guide major architecture decisions across programs, promote shared design standards and reusable models, and resolve high-impact technical trade-offs.&nbsp;<br>• Work across teams to connect solutions into cohesive end-to-end architectures with clear ownership boundaries and integration contracts.&nbsp;<br>• Provide architectural oversight during delivery through design reviews, forums, and governance, keeping cross-cutting concerns (security, performance, resilience, availability, compliance, observability, and cost) aligned across teams.&nbsp;<br>• Promote modular design, clear boundaries, testability, CI/CD, and observability so non-functional requirements are treated as first-class and systems remain reliable and maintainable.&nbsp;<br>• Use AI tools to accelerate discovery, design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and scale successful practices so teams adopt them consistently.<br>• Own architectural standards for lakehouse, streaming, and AI-enabled data platforms.<br>• Guide large-scale Databricks implementations, including multi-region deployments.<br>• Expert knowledge of Data Management, Business Intelligence and Analytics concepts including:&nbsp;<br>• Data Movement (ETL/ELT).<br>• Data Warehousing (Designing and Implementing, Azure SQL, Synapse).<br>• Azure Storage Technologies (Data Lake, Blob Storage).<br>• Data Governance (including Data Quality and Profiling, Master Data Management, and Metadata Management).<br>• Business Intelligence, including Reporting and Visualizations (Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and Scorecards).<br>• Predictive, Prescription, and Descriptive Analytics.<br>• Expert knowledge of Microsoft Azure technologies.<br>• Azure DevOps (including building Stories and tasks, and using development pipelines and ARM templates for publishing code).</p> <p><br>Delivery and Consulting Excellence:&nbsp;</p> <p>• Lead or co-lead executive and senior stakeholder conversations on cloud modernization, platform strategy, AI adoption, and program roadmaps.&nbsp;<br>• Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, and shape delivery plans that balance value, cost, speed, and long-term system health.&nbsp;<br>• Set discovery strategy so program objectives flow into a clear, traceable backlog tied to architecture and business outcomes.&nbsp;<br>• Explain complex architecture and modernization strategies in clear language for executives, business leaders, and technical teams, including options, trade-offs, and recommendations.&nbsp;<br>• Build trusted relationships with technology and business leaders, influencing priorities and investment decisions in ways that help mature their engineering and architecture practices.&nbsp;<br>• Run structured decision-making forums (such as architecture reviews or steering committees) that produce clear decisions, documented rationale, and actionable next steps.&nbsp;<br>• Define architecture, discovery, and delivery frameworks and working agreements that support predictable, incremental delivery across multiple teams and time zones, including cadences, artifacts, escalation paths, and hybrid delivery guidelines.&nbsp;<br>• Align teams on shared outcomes, APIs, integration contracts, and operating models, ensuring crossteam dependencies are identified early, owned, and tracked through to completion.&nbsp;<br>• Support effective use of Agile methods at program scale so architecture, backlogs, and release plans support meaningful increments, stable team velocity, low defect escape, clear definitions of done, and course corrections based on telemetry and feedback.&nbsp;<br>• Track risks, technical debt, quality trends, and architectural drift across teams, and recommend adjustments that keep programs on track while balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term system health.&nbsp;<br>• Support cross-practice opportunity qualification and estimating using playbooks, benchmarks, and templates so the organization focuses on high-fit pursuits and improves proposal quality and confidence in value, risk, and margin.</p> <p><br>Mentorship and Team Development:</p> <p><br>• Mentor Senior Architects, Delivery Architects, and senior engineers, helping them grow systems thinking, architectural judgment, cross-team awareness, and their ability to lead multi-team initiatives.&nbsp;<br>• Provide architectural oversight across programs, modeling pragmatic decision-making, including when to keep solutions simple, when to standardize, when to extend patterns, and when to introduce new technologies.&nbsp;<br>• Help shape career paths and development plans for architects by clarifying expectations for operating at program scale and providing concrete examples of what “good” looks like.&nbsp;<br>• Create and maintain high-leverage learning assets—such as reference implementations, architecture decision records, playbooks, and mentoring guides—that accelerate onboarding and skill growth.&nbsp;<br>• Support hiring, calibration, and talent development by defining interview standards, participating in senior-level interviews and promotion reviews, and training others to apply those standards consistently.&nbsp;<br>• Set a high bar for executive-ready communication and storytelling, and coach others so their narratives support clear decisions and strengthen client trust.&nbsp;<br>• Help build a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement within and across teams, and support new ways of working that endure beyond a single project.</p> <p><br>Growth and Innovation:</p> <p><br>• Grow the company by identifying opportunities within your accounts across all our capabilities and pursuing them with the support of the account team.<br>• Intentionally build executive relationships within accounts to expand our partnership and create opportunities to provide strategic value.<br>• Drive sales opportunities by participating in pursuit teams as either the Pursuit Lead or Technical Solution Lead.<br>• Partner with sales, account, and practice leaders to shape technical strategy for strategic pursuits, projects and/or programs.<br>• Lead the creation of solution options, program-level architectures, and estimates, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and explaining how proposed approaches drive business value and reduce risk.&nbsp;<br>• Operate as a senior technical advisor whose guidance shapes multi-track initiatives and supports long-term account growth.&nbsp;<br>• Identify follow-on and adjacent opportunities—such as platform extensions, additional modernization waves, AI-enabled capabilities, or data estate modernization—that align with client strategies and 3Cloud’s strengths.&nbsp;<br>• Define and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, modernization playbooks, landing zone templates, workshops, accelerators, and starter repositories—that become standard patterns for delivery teams and reduce cycle time and rework while honoring architectural and nonfunctional requirements.&nbsp;<br>• Champion adoption of modern frameworks, cloud platform capabilities, automation practices, and AIassisted tools in a responsible and secure way, using pilots and experiments with clear success criteria to turn innovation into stable, repeatable practice.&nbsp;<br>• Contribute to internal cross-practice initiatives that share patterns and lessons from large programs and reinforce our credibility with clients and partners.&nbsp;<br>• Shape enablement programs that grow capabilities and reusable assets across accounts and package applied innovation into offerings and assets used in delivery and pursuits.</p> <p>Requirements:<br>• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Analytics, or related field.<br>• 12+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary domain such as application development, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, or data and analytics, including significant work at enterprise scale.&nbsp;<br>• 7+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts at program scale.&nbsp;<br>• 10+ years of experience in analytics, data platforms, or enterprise architecture.<br>• Advanced SQL, PySpark and strong understanding of distributed data processing systems.<br>• of business process design and optimization, especially related to data and technology.<br>• Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based modernization, transformation, AI, or platform programs at enterprise scale.&nbsp;<br>• Experience defining solution and platform architectures that connect business strategy with scalable technical design, strong delivery practices, and measurable outcomes.&nbsp;<br>• Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and working with multiple stakeholders across time zones while maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery.&nbsp;<br>• Deep understanding of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in a primary domain, with the ability to apply them at system and program scale.&nbsp;<br>• Experience designing and integrating quality, automation, and observability practices at scale, including automated testing strategies and embedding quality checks into delivery workflows.&nbsp;<br>• Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI and machine learning capabilities into solutions (for example, using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services and tools for code, test, and documentation acceleration).&nbsp;<br>• Significant experience working in Agile or Scrum environments at scale, including backlog structuring, dependency management, integration planning, and release management.&nbsp;<br>• Proven success in consulting or professional services, including client-facing leadership and executive engagement.&nbsp;<br>• Familiarity with key Azure services used in modern solutions that are relevant to your domain (for example, messaging, compute, data, security, networking, management, and integration services).&nbsp;<br>• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills for both technical and business audiences.&nbsp;<br>• Commitment to continuous learning in cloud, data, and AI, with the ability to turn that learning into practical improvements for teams and clients.&nbsp;<br>• Ability to foster culture, inclusion, and community participation across the organization in ways that support rapid cross-team collaboration.&nbsp;<br>• Relevant cloud architecture certifications (for example, Azure-focused architect certifications or comparable role-based certifications) are strongly preferred.</p> <p>Preferred Qualifications:</p> <p><br>• Generative AI &amp; Agentic Systems – applying RAG, prompt engineering, and orchestration with frameworks like Prompt Flow, Semantic Kernel, and AutoGen.&nbsp;<br>• MLOps &amp; Model Lifecycle – CI/CD pipelines, deployment, monitoring, retraining, model governance, and compliance.<br>Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.</p> <p><strong>This Job Posting will expire on <span class="TextRun SCXO74738315 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXO74738315 BCX0"><span class="EOP SCXO74738315 BCX0">Monday, October 12th, 2026.</span></span></span></strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><hr> <p><strong>3Cloud Total Rewards Highlights Include:</strong> &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Flexible work location with a virtual first approach to work! </li> <li>401(K) with match up to 50% of your 6% contributions of eligible pay </li> <li>Generous PTO providing a minimum of 15 days in addition to 9 paid company holidays and 2 floating personal days &nbsp;</li> <li>Two medical plan options to allow you the choice to elect what works best for you!</li> <li>Option for vision and dental coverage </li> <li>100% employer paid coverage for life and disability insurance</li> <li>Paid leave for birth parents and non-birth parents </li> <li>Option for Healthcare FSA, HSA, and Dependent Care FSA</li> <li>$67.00 monthly tech and home office allowance</li> <li>Utilization and/or discretionary bonus eligibility based on role </li> <li>Employee Assistance Program to help with everyday challenges</li> </ul> <p>3Cloud offers competitive compensation. In addition to base pay employees are eligible to receive an annual discretionary/utilization bonus. If you are hired at 3Cloud your final base salary is based on factors such as skills, education, experience and/or geographic location. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above includes the full base salary range for the role. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$168,400</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$217,800 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement?&nbsp;At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.</p> <p><strong>At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.</strong></p></div>

title: EMS Applications Developer Sr.
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. Designs and develops software for a suite of Electric Power Grid applications within the Grid & Market Solutions (GMS) Technology Development – Grid team. The application suite includes Energy Management System (EMS) components such as Topology Processor, Power Flow, State Estimator, Contingency Analysis, Load Frequency Control, Dispatcher Training Simulator (DTS), ICCP, SCADA, CIM Importer, interfaces, Dynamic Stability Analysis, Load and IRR Forecasting, PMU, and Network Model Management System (NMMS). Ensures adherence to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes, including testing and validation of grid applications and user interface changes, to deliver high-quality software solutions. This role also incorporates modern technologies such as containerization, cloud platforms, and AI/ML to enhance scalability, performance, and advanced analytics capabilities. This position reports to the Supervisor/Manager of GMS Technology Development – Grid. JOB DUTIES Understands and apply principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and ERCOT's culture. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Impact is generally limited to specific assignments or projects. May respond to inquiries and/or provide assistance and/or guidance to lower-level workers. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES Level 3 Performs all work in compliance with applicable regulatory regulations, organizational policies, and procedures. Collaborates with internal stakeholders to gather and understand functional and non-functional requirements for grid applications. Designs, develops, and tests grid applications and interfaces using programming languages such as Fortran, C/C++, Java, Perl, and Python in Windows and Linux environments. Designs, develops, and tests backend database changes using Oracle PL/SQL. Supports EMS upgrade projects by migrating custom ERCOT code to upgraded EMS systems. Demonstrates knowledge of linear and nonlinear optimization techniques and understands formulation of optimization objective functions used in grid applications (e.g., SCOPF, SCUC). Develops optimization models incorporating various constraints using solvers like CPLEX and AMPL. Analyzes grid operations and congestion management requirements and develops solutions in EMS applications such as Power Flow, State Estimator, Contingency Analysis, Load Frequency Control, Load Forecasting, Dispatcher Training Simulator (DTS) and ERCOT developed custom applications. Collaborates with the Network Modeling team on CIM data modeling, designs CIM importer schema changes and develops EMS CIM Importer solutions. Troubleshoots and resolves issues related to Voltage and Transient Stability Analysis (VSAT/TSAT) in collaboration with Powertech. Designs and implements IRR (wind/solar) forecast requirements using Siemens WebSDK based tools like Forecast Presentation Platform. Deploys, configures, integrations and tests vendor software releases that include GE EMS, Siemens NMMS, Powertech DSATools, EPG PMU/RTDMS and Itron MetrixIDR. Provides timely resolution of critical production issues as part of a 24x7 Level 2 support team. Automates development processes using CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Maven, and Bitbucket. Develops and delivers training presentations on grid application enhancements. Contributes to development of tools and process improvements to enhance development efficiency. Performs advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for application, database, and system issues. Maintains and supports grid systems in development environments. Develop container-based solutions using tools like Docker and supported by orchestration platforms like Kubernetes for operational requirements where necessary. Designs and implements containerized microservices architectures for grid-based applications. Builds scalable, cloud-native solutions and data pipelines to support growing operational demands for high-performance reliable processing of large-scale systems Apply ERCOT approved Gen AI tools and standardized prompt engineering to improve quality of code and software deliverables. Utilize Machine learning frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, Pandas etc. to embed AI capabilities in existing applications. Develops and deploys AI/ML models for advanced grid analytics, forecasting, and decision support. Conducts code reviews and approves changes made by other developers. Automates unit and regression testing for grid applications suite using scripts and tools like Selenium. Collaborates with grid engineering, systems support, grid operations, training, and network modeling teams to provide technical support for grid applications suite Collaborates with project management to ensure successful delivery of enhancements and upgrades. Ensures compliance of grid application suite with ERCOT architectural standards and employs SDLC processes in all projects. May train, mentor, and oversee other developers. Engages with market participants, ERCOT representatives, and vendors to deliver solutions aligned with ERCOT Electricity market needs. Level Senior - Above + Develop enterprise-level applications and integration solutions. Defines architecture for cloud-native adaptation of existing grid applications and implementation of new applications. Drives adoption of containerization and microservices where deemed necessary to meet operational needs. Leads AI/ML strategy and implementation for grid applications and analytics. Oversee all phases of the software development lifecycle, including analysis, design, testing, and integration. Advocates and aligns business requirements for GMS grid applications and user interfaces to ensure development of effective and user-focused solutions. Provides technical training and presentations for product solutions related to grid applications. Advises management on technical strategy and development goals of the GMS Technology Development team. Works closely with project management team to establish project delivery plan and ensures successful delivery of initiatives. Guides teams across the organization to ensure high-quality product delivery. Acts as a Subject Matter Expert, providing guidance to junior team members and supporting their development through mentoring, training, coaching, and, when needed, coordinating work assignments. Solves moderately complex technical issues requiring in-depth analysis and innovative approaches. Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills to convey team goals effectively. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Level 3: Requires minimum 3 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements Senior Level: Requires minimum 5 years job related work experience in excess of degree requirements Salary and level will be based on overall experience as determined by ERCOT. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience with Energy Management Systems (EMS) or Market Management Systems (MMS) platforms from vendors in the electric industry like GE, Siemens, Hitachi Energy/ABB, OSI, Resource Innovations Power industry experience either with an ISO, utilities, or vendors Experience designing and developing solutions in cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and hybrid architectures Programming in C, C++, Java, Python, Perl, or Fortran Oracle PL/SQL experience Experience with commercial Optimization solvers like CPLEX, AMPL, Gurobi CIM/XML modeling and tools such as PSS/E Experience with developing integration layers using Messaging Services: Tibco JMS, AMQ Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) for scalable and resilient deployments Experience applying AI/ML techniques and data analytics for forecasting, anomaly detection, and operational insights EDUCATION Bachelor's Degree: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Required) Master's Degree: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Preferred) or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required WORK LOCATION – Taylor, TX: Employees will be required to be on-site in Taylor, TX at a minimum of 2 days per week, or more, as needed based on the business needs as determined by management Remote work is required to be performed from your Texas residence. Employees may opt to work on-site more than required or 100% of the time The foregoing description reflects the minimum qualifications and the essential functions of the position that must be performed proficiently with or without reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. It is not an exhaustive list of the duties expected to be performed, and management may, at its discretion, revise or require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned. This job description is not intended to create a contract of employment with ERCOT. Both ERCOT and the employee may exercise their employment-at-will rights at any time. #LI-MH1, #LI-Hybrid ERCOT is firmly committed to equal employment for all qualified persons without regard to race, sex, medical condition, religion, age, creed, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, ancestry, veteran status, genetic information or any other protected category under federal, state or local law. Expected Salary Range: $120,000 - $165,000

title: Senior Application Architect
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. Key Job Duties Define and maintain application architectures across on-prem and cloud-native, microservices, and API-driven systems. Partner with development teams to guide solution design, code quality, and engineering best practices throughout the SDLC. Use AI-assisted tooling (such as Claude, OpenAI, or GitHub Copilot) as part of everyday engineering and architecture work—accelerating design, prototyping, code review, and documentation—and help teams adopt these tools effectively and responsibly. Guide cloud strategy and modernization—including workload assessments, migration and modernization approaches, and foundational design—across cloud environments. Design identity and access management approaches—authentication, authorization, single sign-on, and role- or attribute-based access—and partner with security teams on identity governance and least-privilege access. Establish observability practices—logging, metrics, distributed tracing, profiling, and meaningful alerting—so teams can understand system health and diagnose issues quickly. Promote Infrastructure-as-Code and environment automation to support consistent, repeatable provisioning and environment parity. Help shape CI/CD practices and pipelines, integrating automated testing, security scanning, static analysis, and staged deployments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical roadmaps, architectural standards, and reusable patterns. Provide support for development teams, including API design, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues. Ensure solutions meet enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements. Mentor engineers across application, cloud, identity, and platform disciplines to elevate team capability and technical maturity. Required Professional Skills & Experience Technical Expertise Minimum 5 years of related experience in an architecture or senior engineering capacity. Strong foundation in application architecture, distributed systems, integration, and API design. Hands-on experience designing and operating cloud services in a major public cloud, with the adaptability to work across more than one cloud platform. Working knowledge of identity and access management—authentication and authorization protocols (such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or SAML), single sign-on, role-based access, and enterprise identity providers. Familiarity with observability and monitoring practices—instrumentation, logging, metrics, profiling, and tracing—and one or more supporting tools (e.g., Log Analytics, Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus, or Grafana). Experience with DevOps tooling and CI/CD (such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins). Operational knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code and environment automation (e.g., Terraform, Ansible). Backend development experience in one or more common languages (such as C++, Java, or Python). Comfort using AI-assisted development and productivity tools (such as Claude or OpenAI) in daily work, with sound judgment about where they add value. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Working understanding of security, networking, and governance frameworks. Comfort leading proof-of-concepts and early technical validation—evaluating options, testing key assumptions, and turning findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to design and govern application data models and integration schemas with attention to consistency, data quality, and alignment with enterprise data governance standards. Leadership & Collaboration Ability to influence engineering teams and drive adoption of architectural standards. Strong communication skills for translating complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Clear documentation of technical architecture, decisions, and strategies. Experience guiding teams through SDLC processes, release management, and quality practices. Proven ability to lead modernization and cloud migration initiatives. Preferred Qualifications Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104) or comparable AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or SysOps Administrator). Relevant identity or security certifications, or hands-on experience with identity governance and access management platforms. Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems, or domain-driven design. Exposure to multiple cloud or hybrid environments. Background in enterprise-scale transformation or platform engineering. Education Bachelor's Degree: Computer Science, MIS or related field (Required) Master's Degree: Computer Science, MIS or related field (Preferred) or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required Work Location – Taylor, TX: Employees will be required to be on-site in Taylor, TX at a minimum of 2 days per week, or more, as needed based on the business needs as determined by management On-site schedules are flexible or may be rotated based on business needs as determined by the Manager Remote work is required to be performed from your Texas residence. Employees may opt to work on-site more than required or 100% of the time The foregoing description reflects the minimum qualifications and the essential functions of the position that must be performed proficiently with or without reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. Expected Salary Range: $135,000 - $185,000

title: Senior SharePoint Architect/Developer
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. The Senior SharePoint Architect/Developer drives the architecture, design, development, governance, administration, and continuous improvement of ERCOT’s enterprise collaboration and business productivity platforms, with primary focus on SharePoint Online, Project Server / Project Online, Microsoft Power Platform, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, and related Microsoft 365 services . This role designs secure, scalable, supportable, and compliant collaboration solutions that meet business, operational, and regulatory requirements. The position partners with business stakeholders, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Identity, Compliance, Records Management, and other technology teams to deliver modern collaboration capabilities within ERCOT’s regulated energy environment. The Senior SharePoint Architect/Developer is expected to independently manage complex architecture and development efforts, provide senior-level technical guidance, serve as an escalation point for complex collaboration platform issues, and help mature standards, frameworks, governance models, lifecycle practices, and operational support processes. This role also supports the advancement of Power Platform governance , development of Power Apps and Power Automate solutions for business-critical processes, and the expansion of SharePoint Framework custom web part development using formal SDLC practices. As ERCOT evaluates emerging AI-enabled productivity platforms, this role may also assist with administration, governance, proof-of-concept development, or AI-related application support. Job Duties SharePoint Online and Project Platform Architecture Drive architecture, design, configuration, administration, and continuous improvement of SharePoint Online and Project Server / Project Online solutions. Design secure and scalable site architectures, information architectures, hub sites, metadata models, content types, document libraries, lists, permissions models, search experiences, project sites, templates, workflows, and reporting structures. Partner with business teams to gather requirements, assess business processes, and deliver collaboration and project management solutions aligned with enterprise standards. Modernize legacy SharePoint sites, workflows, InfoPath forms, SharePoint Designer customizations, file shares, and unsupported solutions into modern Microsoft 365 capabilities. Maintain platform architecture standards, design documentation, implementation patterns, support models, and operational guardrails. Troubleshoot advanced SharePoint and Project platform issues related to permissions, access, workflows, forms, search, lists, libraries, web parts, customizations, and integrations. Power Platform Governance and Development Own and mature governance for the Microsoft Power Platform , including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, connectors, environments, data policies, security, lifecycle practices, and support models. Define and maintain Power Platform frameworks, standards, best practices, naming conventions, environment strategies, DLP policies, connector policies, deployment patterns, and operational guardrails. Design, develop, enhance, and support Power Apps and Power Automate solutions that support mainstream, business-critical, or operationally significant business processes. Establish lifecycle management practices for Power Platform solutions, including intake, requirements, design review, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, support, ownership review, and retirement. Partner with business users, citizen developers, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Data Governance, and technology teams to promote responsible Power Platform adoption. SharePoint Framework Custom Development Own the design, development, deployment, governance, and support of SharePoint Framework custom web parts, extensions, and related SharePoint Online customizations . Establish and mature SDLC practices for SPFx development, including requirements, solution design, development standards, source control, peer review, testing, packaging, deployment, documentation, release management, and support. Develop custom SharePoint components using modern technologies such as SPFx, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Visual Studio Code, Git, and Azure DevOps or comparable tooling . Ensure custom solutions preserve SharePoint Online governance, security, compliance, performance, accessibility, and long-term maintainability. Microsoft 365 Collaboration Administration and Governance Administer and support Microsoft 365 collaboration services, including SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, Power Platform, Microsoft Whiteboard, and related services . Configure and support Teams policies, SharePoint sharing settings, OneDrive policies, external sharing controls, guest access, collaboration governance, retention settings, and service configurations. Serve as a senior escalation point for complex collaboration platform incidents, perform root-cause analysis, coordinate remediation, and drive corrective actions. Monitor Microsoft 365 roadmap and Message Center changes, assess business impact, and coordinate change planning, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communications. Support Microsoft 365 usage, adoption, performance, compliance, service health, and governance reporting. Support vendor health assessments, support cases, maintenance notifications, and platform service reviews. Security, Compliance, Automation, and Integration Design and maintain secure collaboration environments through proper permissions management, sharing controls, monitoring, auditing, classification, retention, and governance practices. Coordinate with Cybersecurity and Compliance on data protection, Purview policies, DLP configurations, external sharing, audit requests, evidence collection, and control validation. Support secure Microsoft 365 configurations, including environments aligned with FedRAMP or similar compliance expectations. Use PowerShell and other automation tools to administer, configure, monitor, report on, and maintain Microsoft 365 collaboration services. Develop scripts and automation to improve provisioning, permissions management, auditing, reporting, migration, documentation, and operational efficiency. Integrate SharePoint Online, Power Platform, Project Server / Project Online, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, APIs, and third-party tools where appropriate. Emerging AI Platform Support Support evaluation, administration, configuration, governance, or proof-of-concept development related to emerging enterprise AI and productivity platforms. Assist with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI governance, user adoption, or AI-enabled productivity initiatives as organizational needs mature. Partner with Cybersecurity, Compliance, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to ensure AI-related solutions are evaluated with appropriate attention to data protection, security, compliance, and operational support. Documentation, Training, and Technical Guidance Create and maintain design documentation, technical standards, operational guardrails, migration approaches, service improvement plans, knowledge articles, runbooks, and support documentation. Provide knowledge transfer, mentoring, and task guidance to teammates, support teams, business users, and operational partners. Assist with training technical and non-technical staff on new collaboration tools, governance practices, custom solutions, and platform capabilities. Coordinate related technical work without direct supervisory responsibility. Support organizational change management and help champion effective adoption of Microsoft 365 services aligned with ERCOT business objectives. Required Experience Five years of progressively responsible experience in collaboration platform administration, architecture, development, or related Microsoft 365 technology roles. Senior-level experience with SharePoint Online architecture, administration, development, deployment, migration, governance, and support . Experience with Project Server and/or Project Online architecture, configuration, administration, support, or integration. Experience designing SharePoint site architecture, information architecture, permissions models, metadata structures, document management solutions, search experiences, lists, libraries, workflows, and customizations. Experience developing modern SharePoint Online solutions using SharePoint Framework , TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, or related technologies. Experience establishing or working within formal SDLC practices for custom Microsoft 365 or SharePoint development. Experience developing and supporting Power Apps and Power Automate solutions used for business process automation. Experience with Power Platform governance , including environment strategy, connector policies, DLP policies, security roles, lifecycle management, deployment practices, ownership models, and support processes. Experience deploying, administering, or supporting Microsoft Teams and OneDrive in an enterprise environment. Experience administering Microsoft 365 / Office 365 environments with more than 1,000 users. Strong practical experience with PowerShell for Microsoft 365 administration, automation, reporting, and troubleshooting. Experience with Microsoft 365 migration tools and migration of large volumes of data into cloud collaboration platforms. Experience working in secure, regulated, high-availability, or compliance-driven technology environments. Familiarity with implementing or supporting a FedRAMP-compliant SharePoint Online or Microsoft 365 environment. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, documentation, and organizational skills. Preferred Experience Microsoft 365 tenant administration, including service health monitoring, Message Center review, roadmap impact assessment, and collaboration service governance. Experience with Entra ID identity governance concepts, including service principals, managed identities, conditional access dependencies, federation, and entitlement reviews. Experience with Microsoft Purview, data loss prevention, retention, sensitivity labels, information protection, audit, or compliance configuration. Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot governance, or AI-enabled productivity platforms. Experience with Proofpoint, Exchange Online, email security operations, or cross-platform collaboration/security dependencies. Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and formal deployment governance. Experience with Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Dataverse, custom connectors, or API-based integrations. Experience with DISA STIGs or similar hardening standards. Knowledge of UX/UI best practices, accessibility, and Section 508 compliance. Development experience using Microsoft .NET, Visual Studio, JavaScript, jQuery, web services, APIs, or related technologies. Experience with Intune or endpoint-related Microsoft cloud services. Education Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology , Computer Science, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Computer Information Systems, or a related field is required. An equivalent combination of education and directly related experience may be considered. Preferred Certifications Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, MS-102 Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, SC-300 Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate, SC-400 Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure, or related Microsoft certifications Work Arrangement This position is hybrid and will be physically located in Taylor, Texas, just northeast of Austin. After-hours support may be required for incidents, service-impacting events, production changes, maintenance windows, security events, and other operational needs. #LI-DN ERCOT is firmly committed to equal employment for all qualified persons without regard to race, sex, medical condition, religion, age, creed, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, ancestry, veteran status, genetic information or any other protected category under federal, state or local law. Expected Salary Range: $135,000 - $185,000

title: Staff Customer Operations Analyst
jd_text: About The Role The Staff Customer Operations Analyst is a key member of the Customer Operations team, which coordinates efforts among all internal groups to ensure we are aligned with our customer’s needs and can deliver on our commitments with the highest level of integrity. The role requires strong data analysis and problem-solving skills as well as a creative and inquisitive nature to identify opportunities and address challenges professionally and confidently, along with championing new processes and inspiring other improvements. This role requires strong operational and order management skills and exceptional abilities in customer communication. What You Will Do Envision and execute the strategic direction set by senior management in all areas of inventory and operations. Identify and execute on immediate opportunities. Collaborate with procurement, logistics, and production teams on demand and supply activities to ensure adequate inventory levels are maintained to support the customer service targets. Accountable for supply and demand activities for multiple components, ensuring that performance (inventory, cost, etc.) meets the overall business needs. Leverage ERP systems (SAP preferred) and data to influence decisions. Coordinate with procurement managers to drive improvements and ensure continuity of supply. Analyze business patterns and changes to formulate potential recommendations. Collaborate with key internal and external stakeholders to support customer allocations and priorities. Identify/recognize problems from various perspectives (cross-org) to understand implications and propose solutions. Collaborate with other departments such as quality, engineering, and manufacturing to solve complex problems. Plan and track all inventory to mitigate aging, and drive resolution on excess. Design and develop data processing automations using Python. Develop SQL reporting queries Troubleshoot database issues Develop and maintain BI dashboards What You Bring Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or another quantitative field, with 5 years of experience. Alternatively, Master’s degree with 3 years of experience accepted. 5+ years of experience in a similar role, preferably working in high volume electronics manufacturing environment. Advanced PC skills and expert in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Proficiency in Python a plus Excellent communication, written, and presentation skills. Working knowledge of Tableau/ PowerBI for data visualization and presentation. Working knowledge of financial and accounting principles. Strong analytical and problem solving ability. Experience working in an ERP system (preferably SAP) a plus. Highly detailed planning and organization ability, multitask, set own priorities and adapt to a changing environment. Ability to present complex information to senior leadership and obtain alignment. Teamwork: Works effectively across organizations to achieve company goals and objectives. ZT Systems assesses market data to ensure a competitive compensation package is created for all our employees. The typical base salary for this position is expected to be between $87,375 - $128,150. If hired, the final base salary will be determined on an individual basis taking into consideration experience, skills, knowledge, education and/or certifications. Base salary is just one component of ZT Systems total rewards philosophy. We take pride in offering a wide range of benefits and perks that appeal to the variety of needs across our diverse employee base. Other rewards may include bonus, paid time off, generous 401k match, tuition reimbursement, wellbeing resources, and more. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this opportunity but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. About ZT Systems At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, you’ll get to do work you are proud of alongside smart, passionate people. Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career-defining. A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow. Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world. title: Pharmacy Lead technician
jd_text: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Position Summary: At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our Pharmacy Lead Technicians (Lead Technicians) play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise. As a Lead Technician, you will be an example for and support the pharmacy team in delivering operational and service excellence within your store. Lead Technicians use and build upon the skills and responsibilities of the Pharmacy Technician/Inventory Specialist, acting as a role model, mentor, and guide to the pharmacy team while supporting the Pharmacy Manager and all Pharmacist(s). As an individual contributor and participant-leader, Lead Technicians assist in ensuring that pharmacy operations run smoothly; patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately; and that the team provides caring service that exceeds patient expectations. Lead Technicians champion and coach consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication with the pharmacy team. Throughout their shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, they demonstrate genuine care and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered. The Lead Technician is responsible for adhering to and championing safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to: Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and pharmacy team manage and improve patient health Following, and coaching the pharmacy team to follow, pharmacy workflow and procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems Assisting the Pharmacist-on-duty with managing day-to-day activities and delegated administrative tasks, which may include pharmacy scheduling and review of the Digital Workstation Assignment Board, daily/weekly communications, and daily/weekly reporting Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices; providing pharmacy team performance feedback to the Pharmacy Manager, as needed, to contribute to their growth and development Overseeing and/or completing inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries, helping to prepare for and participating in annual physical inventories, and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc., acting as back-up and providing mentoring and coaching to the Inventory Specialist where applicable Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand leadership competencies, alongside clinical and technical knowledge, to better assist patients Serving as a trusted source of truth to the pharmacy team, using judgement to escalate issues and referring colleagues to the appropriate support channel, as needed (e.g., Pharmacy Manager, Asset Protection, Colleague Relations, Ethics Line, etc.) Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. Complying with CVS policies and procedures to ensure patient safety, compliance with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, and to protect patient privacy and security Delivering additional patient health care services (e.g., immunizations, point-of-care testing, and voluntarily staffing offsite clinics), where allowable by law and supported by required training and certification Where permissible, the Lead Technician may also support immunizations, which includes the following responsibilities: Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines Educating the pharmacy team on the benefits of becoming a certified immunizer and delivering immunizations to patients Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient Required Qualifications: 1+ years of experience as a Pharmacy Technician Must comply with any state board of pharmacy requirements or laws governing the practice of pharmacy, which includes but is not limited to, age, education, and licensure/certification If the state board of pharmacy does not address or mandate a minimum age requirement, must be at least 18 years of age as allowed by state employment laws If the state board of pharmacy does not address or mandate a minimum educational requirement, must have a high school diploma or equivalent, as defined by the state, or be actively enrolled in high school or high school equivalency program State-level licensure requirements vary by state , click here to learn more. title: Machine Maintenance Support
jd_text: Job Title: Machine Maintenance Support Job Description: Entegris is currently seeking a Machining Maintenance Technician IV for our Decatur, TX facility. In this role, you will provided advanced CNC maintenance services to support the production goals of the company. With the need to control machine down time, a Machining Maintenance Technician will be able to handle hands on repair and coordinate with vendors to achieve maximum machine reliability. What You’ll Do: Work on equipment installation, relocation, upgrades, and repairs Service several types and brands of CNC’s including: EDM, Wire saw, laser engraving, robot loaders, machine tools (Mazak, Gardner, GF+, Chevalier, Takamaz) Self-diagnose highly technical Machine Tool problems and lead repairs to completion. Run the Renishaw Ball bar to measure axis alignment and precisely calculate the needed mechanical and electrical adjustments to set the machine to within microns. Program PLC ladder logic and keeper bits to diagnose and repair Fanuc, and Mazatrol machinery. Establish communication protocols for drip feed programming parameters, and PMC backups Teach and repair: Yaskawa, Fanuc Robotics, and other automated gantry machine loaders Troubleshoot, electrical components such as contactors, switches, relays, and controllers Lead facility capital projects, and comprehensive FMEA’s to help improve the manufacturing process Must be able to schedule and coordinate with OEM experts to complete PM’s and repairs on time as needed. Operate Lathe and Mill for custom fabrication. Work with operators to improve day-to-day machine operations and update documents if needed Order parts and track materials list to complete upcoming projects Prepare Metrics for maintenance cost, and machine downtime. Be exposed to outdoor working conditions, and dusty or dirty environments, or even clean rooms. Take part in after-hours “On-Call” responsibilities as part of the maintenance team rotation lasting 7 consecutive days at a time. What We Seek: 4+ Years Machine Tool Maintenance background Familiarity with rebuilds utilizing Gib and Way Scraping and Turcite installation Mechanical aptitude, working knowledge of ball screws, worm gears, transmissions, etc. Electrical aptitude, working knowledge of safety circuits, timers, servo's, HMIs, etc. Preferred knowledge in (Fadal, Haas, Mitsubishi, Hardinge, Okamoto and Chevalier) Diverse maintenance background including servicing: blowers, vacuum pumps, augers, gas furnaces, hydraulic and pneumatic systems Retrofit, upgrade, and design hydraulic and pneumatic systems. Astute attention to detail to help drive Safety and Quality. Able to climb stairs and ladders, and safely lift 50 lbs. Ability to perform visual checks and handle materials responsibly while wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) meeting NFPA 70E requirements. Experienced operator of Engine hoists, Cranes, Forklifts, Scissor Lifts, Articulated Booms, and Front End loaders. Utilize personal tools for precision alignments including concentric shafts. Welding to create new physical structures or modifications for equipment. Meticulously documentation using Microsoft products to capture and improve SOP’s, inventory management, OEE, machine tool history, expenditures, and MTBF Some Flexibility in working schedule due to projects, breakdown situations, etc. Candidate must have the capacity to comply with the federally mandated requirements of U.S. export control laws.
