title: Operations Manager
jd_text: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Position Summary The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example. The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including: Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation Sales and inventory management Employee staffing, training, and development Financial management Customer service leadership Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings. Essential Functions: 1. Management Lead others and work effectively with store crews Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement 2. Customer Service Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank) Required Qualifications Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills. Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise Preferred Qualifications Experience as a retail manager or supervisor Education High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required. Anticipated Weekly Hours 40 Time Type Full time Pay Range The typical pay range for this role is: $19.00 - $29.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. Great benefits for great people We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments . We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/14/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

title: Litigation and Claims Operations Specialist
location: US TX Houston 7402 N Eldridge Pkwy
jd_text: At DNOW, we believe our associates are the best in the business. We value and reward hardworking, creative, and dedicated employees that desire to be part of a team committed to outstanding customer service. START YOUR CAREER NOW. The Litigation and Claims Operations Specialist supports the legal department’s dispute resolution and legal operations functions by managing pre-litigation claims, coordinating litigation support activities throughout the duration of the filing, and completing other tasks as needed. This role will report to the Assistant General Counsel. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Serve as a central administrative point of contact for dispute-related matters, tracking matter statuses, deadlines, budgets, next steps, and responsible parties. Manage pre-litigation claims in coordination with the Third-Party Administrator (TPA), including evaluating liability exposure, determining strategy, and providing settlement authority to resolve pre-litigation claims. Serve as the main point of contact for any incoming subpoenas and regulatory inquiries. Independently evaluate initial scope, determine affected internal business units, and coordinate response logistics. Provide litigation support, including assisting with responding to discovery requests under attorney supervision and organizing and managing electronic and physical files. Draft and finalize legal hold orders under attorney supervision. Issue, track, and audit compliance for legal hold orders and custodian releases. Audit and process invoices for payment, including coordinating with outside counsel / vendors, TPAs, and Accounts Payable to set up accounts, monitor payment statuses, and resolve any billing discrepancies. Complete special projects and other responsibilities, as assigned. JOB REQUIREMENTS: Minimum 5 years of litigation support experience, preferably at a law firm or in-house legal department. Experience working with TPAs on pre-litigation claims as well as any mass tort background or experience preferred. Strong organizational, analytical, and attention-to-detail skills. Ability to work collaboratively as a member of a team and committed to promoting a positive culture. Ability to effectively communicate and draft and review documents. Ability to exercise sound judgment and escalate or seek clarification as needed. Goal-oriented with the ability to multi-task under pressure in fast-paced work environment Problem solving skills. Self-starter mentality who has the ability to work independently with limited oversight. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams). BENEFITS: Competitive salary + potentially eligible for annual bonus 401(k)/ retirement savings Comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage) Paid vacation/holidays

title: Senior Engineer, Continuous Improvement
jd_text: Job Title: Senior Engineer, Continuous Improvement Job Description: The Role: Our site in Burnet, TX , is seeking a Senior Engineer, C ontinuous Improvement . The CI Leader Engineer will play a critical role in driving lean transformation of the Burnet factory . Leveraging deep expertise in process mapping, Six Sigma , Lean and high-impact transformations, this individual will ensure that lean initiatives are designed and driven for success, implemented and sustained. As a key contributor to the operations team , this Engineer will help assess processe s and KPI’s across the Burnet site and ensure improvement roadmaps are defined, executed, and sustained. This role will also coordinate with the larger CI community to share best practices and learnings to drive the Entegris Way mindset. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Lead Continuous Improvement Initiatives: Develop and implement CI strategies to streamline processes and eliminate waste to drive visual factory and process optimizations through Tier Daily Management . Utilize methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen to drive process improvements. Assess and Optimize Processes: Conduct thorough assessments of current processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement. Implement Lean principles to optimize these processes and help with digital transformation. Collaborate Across Functions: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, operations, and business units, to ensure that Lean improvements are integrated seamlessly with digital technologies. Drive Cultural Change: Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. Provide training and support to employees to adopt Lean methodologies and new digital tools and processes. Monitor and Measure Impact: Establish metrics and KPIs to track the effectiveness of Lean and continuous improvement initiatives. Analyze data to identify trends and areas for further enhancement. Facilitate Workshops and Training: Conduct workshops and training sessions to educate employees on Lean methodologies and digital tools. Facilitate Continuous Improvement Programs: Lead Kaizen events to improve business processes, waste identification using Value Stream Maps and devise plans to improve efficiency. WHAT WE SEEK: Bachelor's d egree in Industrial engineering, or related engineering disciplines Minimum of 5 - 8 years’ experience in a manufacturing environment driving Lean and Six Sigma programs across a large-scale and diverse manufacturing footprint Experience in driving a lean and digitize mindset across the supply chain with a global team Formal Six Sigma training and associated Lean, Blackbelt and SPC credentials Willing to travel but less than 10% OUTSTANDING CANDIDATES WILL HAVE: Proven track record of developing, implementing and sustaining a CI culture across a global enterprise Direct supplier, Customer and factory experience in managing CI portfolios with measurable efficiency gains Hands-on leadership style and a sense of urgency to assist stakeholders WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS? Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office. WHAT WE OFFER Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Compensation: The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $135,000 per year. Final compensation will depend on the candidate's overall skills and qualifications for the role. Annual bonus eligibility Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs Education assistance to support your learning journey A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future. At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

title: Director - Data Platforms & Architecture
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!</p> <p>At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.</p></div><p>The Director in Delivery leads multiple teams and managers, ensuring each group is healthy, highperforming, and aligned to service line priorities. They also lead architecture for large Azure programs that span applications, platforms, and data. You connect business goals to cloud modernization roadmaps,&nbsp;define architecture frameworks, and guide multi-team execution.</p> <p>At this level, you act as an organization-wide technical leader. You set technical direction across practices, orchestrate cross-team discovery, keep designs aligned across multiple teams, and turn successful patterns into reusable models. You promote strong engineering, automation, and AI-assisted practices, mentor Senior Architects and Delivery Architects, and help build an inclusive, continuously improving engineering culture while supporting clear investment and modernization decisions for 3Cloud and our clients.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong><br>People Leadership Expectations&nbsp;<br>• Maintain a clear view of each team member's delivery commitments, growth plans, and internal contributions.&nbsp;<br>• Develop and grow team members through regular coaching, clear expectations, and constructive feedback. Build a culture of trust, inclusion, and collaboration.&nbsp;<br>• Monitor team health, morale, and workload balance, acting early to address engagement or performance concerns in partnership with practice leadership.&nbsp;<br>• Maintain regular one-to-one connections with each team member, provide clear feedback, and help them remove blockers related to client work, pursuits, or internal initiatives.&nbsp;<br>• Oversee staffing and resource alignment across teams, balancing utilization, development goals, client needs, and sustainable workloads.&nbsp;<br>• Communicate practice priorities and organizational objectives clearly, ensuring teams understand&nbsp; how their work contributes to broader organizational goals.&nbsp;<br>• Define interview standards and mentorship strategies, training others to apply them consistently and improving hiring outcomes and talent growth at scale.&nbsp;<br>• Create and maintain development plans for team members, including stretch assignments, shadowing, certifications, and opportunities for external visibility.<br>• Lead or support performance reviews, promotion recommendations, and compensation input for your teams, using consistent standards that reflect both impact and behavior.<br>• Represent your teams in leadership forums, communicate expectations and decisions clearly back to the group, and bring forward patterns, risks, and successes that should shape practice strategy.<br>Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership<br>• Lead architecture and technical strategy for large Azure programs and portfolios so solutions meet client goals for value, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.&nbsp;<br>• Define modernization blueprints and reference architectures across applications, platforms, and data, including system and subsystem designs, patterns, and standards that simplify delivery and&nbsp; operations over time.&nbsp;<br>• Translate business and product strategy into cloud architecture roadmaps and execution plans that drive measurable outcomes and adapt based on production feedback and telemetry.&nbsp;<br>• Guide major architecture decisions across programs, promote shared design standards and reusable models, and resolve high-impact technical trade-offs.&nbsp;<br>• Work across teams to connect solutions into cohesive end-to-end architectures with clear ownership boundaries and integration contracts.&nbsp;<br>• Provide architectural oversight during delivery through design reviews, forums, and governance, keeping cross-cutting concerns (security, performance, resilience, availability, compliance,&nbsp; observability, and cost) aligned across teams.&nbsp;<br>• Promote modular design, clear boundaries, testability, CI/CD, and observability so non-functional requirements are treated as first-class and systems remain reliable and maintainable.&nbsp;<br>• Use AI tools to accelerate discovery, design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and scale successful practices so teams adopt them consistently.<br>• Data Platform Strategy &amp; Architecture Direction:<br>• Define and own enterprise data platform strategy centered on Databricks or equivalent lakehouse architectures.<br>• Establish reference architectures spanning ingestion, lakehouse, analytics, and AI/ML.<br>• Set standards and best practices for:&nbsp;<br>• Databricks lakehouse design and workload isolation.<br>• Delta Lake optimization and data lifecycle management.<br>• Streaming and batch processing patterns.<br>• Unity Catalog–aligned governance and security models.<br>• Guide multi-workspace and multi-region Databricks deployments.&nbsp;<br>• Ensure tight integration between Databricks, Azure-native services, and downstream analytics tools.<br>• Oversee architectural alignment with complementary platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Fabric, Power BI).</p> <p>Delivery and Consulting Excellence<br>• Lead or co-lead executive and senior stakeholder conversations on cloud modernization, platform strategy, AI adoption, and program roadmaps.&nbsp;<br>• Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, and shape delivery plans that balance value, cost, speed, and long-term system health.&nbsp;<br>• Set discovery strategy so program objectives flow into a clear, traceable backlog tied to architecture and business outcomes.&nbsp;<br>• Explain complex architecture and modernization strategies in clear language for executives, business leaders, and technical teams, including options, trade-offs, and recommendations.&nbsp;<br>• Build trusted relationships with technology and business leaders, influencing priorities and investment decisions in ways that help mature their engineering and architecture practices.&nbsp;<br>• Run structured decision-making forums (such as architecture reviews or steering committees) that produce clear decisions, documented rationale, and actionable next steps.&nbsp;<br>• Define architecture, discovery, and delivery frameworks and working agreements that support predictable, incremental delivery across multiple teams and time zones, including cadences, artifacts, escalation paths, and hybrid delivery guidelines.&nbsp;<br>• Align teams on shared outcomes, APIs, integration contracts, and operating models, ensuring crossteam dependencies are identified early, owned, and tracked through to completion.&nbsp;<br>• Support effective use of Agile methods at program scale so architecture, backlogs, and release plans support meaningful increments, stable team velocity, low defect escape, clear definitions of done, and course corrections based on telemetry and feedback.&nbsp;<br>• Track risks, technical debt, quality trends, and architectural drift across teams, and recommend adjustments that keep programs on track while balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term system health.&nbsp;<br>• Support cross-practice opportunity qualification and estimating using playbooks, benchmarks, and templates so the organization focuses on high-fit pursuits and improves proposal quality and confidence in value, risk, and margin.</p> <p>Mentorship and Team Development<br>• Mentor Senior Architects, Delivery Architects, and senior engineers, helping them grow systems thinking, architectural judgment, cross-team awareness, and their ability to lead multi-team initiatives.<br>• Provide architectural oversight across programs, modeling pragmatic decision-making, including when to keep solutions simple, when to standardize, when to extend patterns, and when to introduce new technologies.&nbsp;<br>• Help shape career paths and development plans for architects by clarifying expectations for operating at program scale and providing concrete examples of what “good” looks like.&nbsp;<br>• Create and maintain high-leverage learning assets—such as reference implementations, architecture decision records, playbooks, and mentoring guides—that accelerate onboarding and skill growth.&nbsp;<br>• Support hiring, calibration, and talent development by defining interview standards, participating in senior-level interviews and promotion reviews, and training others to apply those standards consistently.&nbsp;<br>• Set a high bar for executive-ready communication and storytelling, and coach others so their narratives support clear decisions and strengthen client trust.&nbsp;<br>• Help build a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement within and across teams, and support new ways of working that endure beyond a single project.</p> <p>Growth and Innovation<br>• Grow the company by identifying opportunities within your accounts across all our capabilities and pursuing them with the support of the account team.<br>• Intentionally build executive relationships within accounts to expand our partnership and create opportunities to provide strategic value.<br>• Drive sales opportunities by participating in pursuit teams as either the Pursuit Lead or Technical Solution Lead.<br>• Partner with sales, account, and practice leaders to shape technical strategy for strategic pursuits, projects and/or programs.<br>• Lead the creation of solution options, program-level architectures, and estimates, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and explaining how proposed approaches drive business value and reduce risk.&nbsp;<br>• Operate as a senior technical advisor whose guidance shapes multi-track initiatives and supports long-term account growth.&nbsp;<br>• Identify follow-on and adjacent opportunities—such as platform extensions, additional modernization waves, AI-enabled capabilities, or data estate modernization—that align with client strategies and 3Cloud’s strengths.&nbsp;<br>• Define and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, modernization playbooks, landing zone templates, workshops, accelerators, and starter repositories—that become standard patterns for delivery teams and reduce cycle time and rework while honoring architectural and nonfunctional requirements.&nbsp;<br>• Champion adoption of modern frameworks, cloud platform capabilities, automation practices, and AIassisted tools in a responsible and secure way, using pilots and experiments with clear success criteria to turn innovation into stable, repeatable practice.&nbsp;<br>• Contribute to internal cross-practice initiatives that share patterns and lessons from large programs and reinforce our credibility with clients and partners.&nbsp;<br>• Shape enablement programs that grow capabilities and reusable assets across accounts and package applied innovation into offerings and assets used in delivery and pursuits.</p> <p><strong>Requirements</strong><br>• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field preferred<br>• 12+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary domain such as application development, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, or data and analytics, including significant work at enterprise scale.&nbsp;<br>• 7+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts at program scale.&nbsp;<br>• 10+ years of experience in data platforms, data engineering, or consulting.<br>• Deep architectural expertise with Databricks, including Spark optimization, Delta Lake, and workload design.<br>• Strong understanding of Azure-native data services and cloud architecture.<br>• Proven experience in architecting and implementing solutions using Microsoft technologies.&nbsp;<br>• Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based modernization, transformation, AI, or platform programs at enterprise scale.&nbsp;<br>• Experience defining solution and platform architectures that connect business strategy with scalable technical design, strong delivery practices, and measurable outcomes.&nbsp;<br>• Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and working with multiple stakeholders across time zones while maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery.&nbsp;<br>• Deep understanding of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in a primarydomain, with the ability to apply them at system and program scale.&nbsp;<br>• Experience designing and integrating quality, automation, and observability practices at scale, including automated testing strategies and embedding quality checks into delivery workflows.&nbsp;<br>• Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI and machine learning capabilities into solutions (for example, using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services and tools for code, test, and documentation acceleration).&nbsp;<br>• Significant experience working in Agile or Scrum environments at scale, including backlog structuring, dependency management, integration planning, and release management.&nbsp;<br>• Proven success in consulting or professional services, including client-facing leadership and executive engagement.&nbsp;<br>• Familiarity with key Azure services used in modern solutions that are relevant to your domain (for example, messaging, compute, data, security, networking, management, and integration services).&nbsp;<br>• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills for both technical and business audiences.&nbsp;<br>• Commitment to continuous learning in cloud, data, and AI, with the ability to turn that learning into practical improvements for teams and clients.&nbsp;<br>• Ability to foster culture, inclusion, and community participation across the organization in ways that support rapid cross-team collaboration.</p> <p>• Relevant cloud architecture certifications (for example, Azure-focused architect certifications or&nbsp;<br>comparable role-based certifications) are strongly preferred.</p> <p>Preferred Qualifications&nbsp;<br>• Experience with multiple cloud vendors and complementary platforms such as Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI.<br>• Experience creating data platform offerings.<br>• Relevant certifications (Databricks Champion, Databricks Professional level, Azure Solutions Architect Expert.</p> <p><br>Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with&nbsp;every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><hr> <p><strong>3Cloud Total Rewards Highlights Include:</strong> &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Flexible work location with a virtual first approach to work! </li> <li>401(K) with match up to 50% of your 6% contributions of eligible pay </li> <li>Generous PTO providing a minimum of 15 days in addition to 9 paid company holidays and 2 floating personal days &nbsp;</li> <li>Two medical plan options to allow you the choice to elect what works best for you!</li> <li>Option for vision and dental coverage </li> <li>100% employer paid coverage for life and disability insurance</li> <li>Paid leave for birth parents and non-birth parents </li> <li>Option for Healthcare FSA, HSA, and Dependent Care FSA</li> <li>$67.00 monthly tech and home office allowance</li> <li>Utilization and/or discretionary bonus eligibility based on role </li> <li>Employee Assistance Program to help with everyday challenges</li> </ul> <p>3Cloud offers competitive compensation. In addition to base pay employees are eligible to receive an annual discretionary/utilization bonus. If you are hired at 3Cloud your final base salary is based on factors such as skills, education, experience and/or geographic location. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above includes the full base salary range for the role. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$162,800</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$244,200 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement?&nbsp;At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.</p> <p><strong>At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.</strong></p></div>

data-end="278">About the Role</h1> <p data-start="280" data-end="729">6sense is the GTM Intelligence Platform, and Foundation is the layer the rest of it stands on — "platform, data, infrastructure: the backbone everything builds on." It owns account and people data, matching and identity, the APIs and MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and the workflows that move data through the system. When buyers ask whether 6sense is accurate, extensible, secure, and composable, the answer lives here.</p> <p data-start="731" data-end="1280">We're looking for a Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for the Foundation pillar. This is the most technical seat on the PMM team. You'll translate deep capabilities — identity resolution, data coverage and accuracy, API extensibility, the MCP framework, security and compliance — into differentiated stories that win over the technical and economic buyers who scrutinize them: RevOps architects, IT and security teams, data leaders, and increasingly developers building agentic GTM stacks.</p> <p data-start="1282" data-end="1639">You'll also carry one of the most strategically important narratives in the company: that 6sense is a composable intelligence layer other systems and AI agents plug into — "AI to the data, not data to the AI" — rather than a closed destination. With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly.</p> <hr data-start="1641" data-end="1644"> <h1 data-section-id="bq35um" data-start="1646" data-end="1663">What You'll Own</h1> <ul data-start="1665" data-end="3578"> <li data-section-id="13n20zr" data-start="1665" data-end="1952">Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.</li> <li data-section-id="1g6k9xx" data-start="1953" data-end="2231">Technical proof. Turn capability into credibility: architecture explainers, technical briefs and whitepapers, benchmarks, and reference narratives that substantiate the "backbone everything builds on" claim — especially around data accuracy, coverage, and identity resolution.</li> <li data-section-id="wcbmhg" data-start="2232" data-end="2477">The composable / MCP-agent story. Own the infrastructure-layer narrative — 6sense as the data and intelligence layer that agentic GTM stacks compose with. Lead GTM for the MCP framework and the developer / technical-buyer audience it opens up.</li> <li data-section-id="3qqui0" data-start="2478" data-end="2709">Differentiation for the data and identity layer. Make the case against point data providers and infrastructure alternatives — coverage, match rates, identity quality, enrichment, security posture — and arm the field to win on it.</li> <li data-section-id="hwlvmj" data-start="2710" data-end="2982">Field and partner enablement for technical evaluations. Build the battlecards, objection handling, FAQs, and solution content that win RFPs, security reviews, and technical POCs. Partner with Sales Engineering to make the technical buyer's diligence a place 6sense wins.</li> <li data-section-id="1om1lgp" data-start="2983" data-end="3183">Launches. Drive end-to-end GTM for Foundation releases: new data assets, API and MCP capabilities, security packages (SCIM, SSO role mapping, audit, custom roles), connectors, and workflow features.</li> <li data-section-id="1e148xz" data-start="3184" data-end="3436">Cross-functional partnership. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Foundation Product and Engineering leaders to shape roadmap-to-market, and with Customer Success to surface the post-sale and admin/security use cases that prove the platform's breadth.</li> <li data-section-id="rnwvuw" data-start="3437" data-end="3578">Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations.</li> </ul> <hr data-start="3580" data-end="3583"> <h1 data-section-id="1hq1k3c" data-start="3585" data-end="3604">What You'll Bring</h1> <ul data-start="3606" data-end="4975"> <li data-section-id="1rwjcjz" data-start="3606" data-end="3805">8+ years in product marketing, technical product management, or a closely related function, with substantial technical PMM experience for platform, data, infrastructure, API, or developer products.</li> <li data-section-id="jnrpo7" data-start="3806" data-end="4073">A proven ability to translate technical concepts — APIs, data pipelines, identity resolution, integrations, security, and AI/agent architectures like MCP — into crisp positioning and business value, without losing the engineers in the room or the buyers outside it.</li> <li data-section-id="5yz5qn" data-start="4074" data-end="4218">A track record owning messaging for technical products and enabling technical sales motions (Sales Engineering, RFPs, security reviews, POCs).</li> <li data-section-id="l7q2rk" data-start="4219" data-end="4447">Hands-on, not hand-wavy. You'll personally call the APIs, stand up and configure the MCP server, connect it to an agent, and build the demo — and your messaging is sharper because you've done the thing, not just read the spec.</li> <li data-section-id="dbk7su" data-start="4448" data-end="4598">Strong writing — you can produce content that is technically rigorous and genuinely clear, from a one-line value prop to an architecture whitepaper.</li> <li data-section-id="189yqu4" data-start="4599" data-end="4793">Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, or data platforms, and comfort selling to technical and economic buyers (RevOps architects, IT, security, data teams, developers).</li> <li data-section-id="1hsqk4j" data-start="4794" data-end="4975">The judgment and presence to operate as a senior individual contributor: set strategy, lead cross-functionally without authority, and influence product and executive stakeholders.</li> </ul> <hr data-start="4977" data-end="4980"> <h1 data-section-id="1dtylgm" data-start="4982" data-end="4996">Nice to Have</h1> <ul data-start="4998" data-end="5404"> <li data-section-id="11i6t7q" data-start="4998" data-end="5170">Hands-on familiarity with data enrichment and identity (waterfall enrichment, matching, intent data), MCP and agentic AI architectures, or composable/API-first platforms.</li> <li data-section-id="q1le92" data-start="5171" data-end="5295">Experience marketing to developers or technical evaluators, including documentation-adjacent and developer-community work.</li> <li data-section-id="1afbpdh" data-start="5296" data-end="5404">Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms.</li> </ul> <hr data-start="5406" data-end="5409"> <h1 data-section-id="8crj8w" data-start="5411" data-end="5436">What Success Looks Like</h1> <p data-start="5438" data-end="5855">In your first 6–12 months, Foundation has a differentiated, defensible position that technical buyers recognize; the composable/MCP infrastructure story is landed with the field and the market as something that exists today, not a roadmap promise; the data and identity credibility story is substantiated with proof, not assertion; title: Store Associate
jd_text: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Position Summary Retail Store Associates play a meaningful role within the CVS Health family. At CVS Health, we’re shaping the future of health care for people, businesses, and communities. With your talents and expertise, you can help us play a more active and supportive role in each person’s unique healthcare needs. Join our team of thousands as we positively impact millions…one customer at a time. The Retail Store Associate position provides an opportunity, in a leading retail setting, to excel in a growing, high impact, customer focused role, working both independently and as a member of a team, to positively impact the lives of others. Essential Functions: Providing differentiated customer service by anticipating customer needs, demonstrating compassion and care in all interactions, and actively identifying and resolving potential service issues Focusing on the customer by giving a warm and friendly greeting, maintaining eye contact and offering help locating additional items, when needed Accurately perform cashier duties - handling cash, checks and credit card transactions with precision while following company policies and procedures Maintaining the sales floor by restocking shelves, checking in vendors, updating pricing information and completing inventory management tasks as directed by store manager Supporting opening and closing store activities, when needed Providing customer support to all departments, including photo and beauty, ensuring departments are fully stocked and operational while remaining current with all updated services and tools Assisting pharmacy personnel when needed, including working regular shifts in the pharmacy as part of opportunities for growth and career development Embracing and advocating for new CVS services and loyalty programs that support our purpose of helping people on their path to better health To gain additional insight into this opportunity, watch the brief video below to learn more about the role, our team, and the rewarding work we do. Store Associate Required Qualifications At least 16 years of age Physical Requirements: Remaining upright on the feet, particularly for sustained periods of time Lifting and exerting up to 35 lbs of force occasionally, up to 10 lbs of force frequently, and a negligible amount of force regularly to move objects to and from, including overhead lifting Visual Acuity - Having close visual acuity to perform activities such as: viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts/details Preferred Qualifications Previous experience in a retail or customer service setting Education High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required. title: QA/QC Manager - Data Center Construction
jd_text: At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 10 rankings in ENR. With over 60 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless! We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated QA/QC Manager to be part of our team in Fort Worth, TX. The QA/QC Manager for Data Center Construction will oversee all quality assurance and quality control functions for a major new build data center project. This role ensures construction meets mechanical, electrical, and process requirements while maintaining full compliance with owner's standards and specifications. You may lead a team of discipline specific quality inspectors, manage documentation, coordinate with contractors, and support turnover and commissioning activities. The successful candidate must be self-motivated, technically skilled, highly organized, communicate clearly and have a proven ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment. Candidates’ work history must represent increased levels of responsibility on a progressive basis throughout their career. A relocation package may be available for outstanding candidates. RESPONSIBILITIES Develop, implement, and maintain the project-wide QA/QC plan in alignment with semiconductor facility standards. Establish inspection and testing protocols for mechanical, electrical, structural, and equipment installations. Lead quality meetings with contractors, engineering teams, and the owner. Manage the project's quality documentation structure (DWNs, NCRs, RFIs, QA logs, closeout document requirements). Observes commissioning meetings and updates senior project management on project commissioning progress, targets, and risk elements Collaboration with project construction teams to fine tune the construction schedule and integrate all the necessary equipment and system components to meet pre-requisites for equipment tagging. Verifies that the General Contractors uphold obligations with respect to their commissioning and quality program deliverables. Ensures equipment maintenance via the Construction Manager is upheld until handover. Maintains the warranty program and follows up on completion of warranty tasks. Review documentation for completeness and compliance with best quality practices and in accordance with AHJ, General Contractor and owner requirements. Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety, Security requirements, and programs. Coordinate with the owner on all quality matters. Prior to the start of construction, meet with the owner or authorized representative to review the details of the contractor’s Quality Control Plan's components, forms, control activities, testing and any other items to ensure a complete and mutual understanding of the QC plan and procedures and alignment with the site Quality Assurance Plan and project specifications Participate in internal and external site audits Monitor the implementation of the approved site Quality Assurance Plan Coordinate with the site construction lead on all quality issues and provide technical support to resolve quality issues. Assure all technical documents related to site quality control are utilized Manage Owner’s 3rd Party Special Inspection Agencies REQUIREMENTS Minimum 6 years of construction experience and quality control management or industrial Building Inspector experience, ideally in data center or industrial projects. General knowledge of other applicable codes and standards. Knowledge of QAQC CPM scheduling in the construction environment. Have experience with interpreting and enforcing contract requirements, drawings, specifications and applicable codes. Demonstrated proficiency and experience with the following tools: Microsoft Office software. Experience with document control and commissioning software programs would be beneficial. EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in construction management, architecture or engineering, or related field preferred Equivalent experience in the field will be considered in lieu of formal education. #LI-VM1 Cumming Group is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunity in its personnel policies and practices. It is Cumming Group’s policy to recruit, hire, train and promote Team Members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex, marital status, registered domestic partner status, genetic information, sexual preference, sexual orientation, gender (including gender expression and gender identity), pregnancy (including childbirth or related medical conditions, including breastfeeding), military service, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical disability, mental disability, veteran status or any other protected classification under federal, state, or local law. All such decisions are based on (1) individual merit, qualifications, and competence as they relate to the particular position, and (2) promotion of the principle of equal employment opportunity. All other terms and conditions of employment, such as compensation, benefits, transfers, layoff, return from layoff, training, education, and social and recreational programs, are administered without regard to the characteristics described above. To this end, Cumming Group complies with all provisions of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 as amended, all of the rules, regulations and relevant orders of the Secretary of Labor, and all similar state and local laws. The salary range for this full-time role is $104,600.00-$139,466.68 per year. Ranges are determined based on the position, geography, client and industry experience and level, and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range reflects base salary only, and not the total compensation package. Cumming Group reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, including client requirements. In addition to base salary, Cumming Group offers a comprehensive benefits package including: Medical Dental Insurance Vision Insurance 401(k) 401(k) Matching Paid Time Off Paid Holidays Short and long-term disability Employee Assistance Program

title: Managing Consultant, EHS Compliance Project Manager
jd_text: Lead the transformation of EHS programs from compliance obligations to strategic business advantages. At ERM , we help organizations solve complex environmental, health, and safety challenges while advancing operational excellence and sustainability. As a Managing Consultant, Safe and Sustainable Operations , you will play a strategic leadership role helping clients strengthen EHS performance, manage risk, and build resilient operations. Based in Houston, Texas , this position offers the opportunity to lead high-impact projects, advise global organizations, develop client relationships, and influence the future of EHS programs across a wide range of industries. Why This Role Matters In this role, you will play a pivotal role in helping organizations move beyond basic compliance toward resilient, high-performing EHS programs. In this role, you will manage projects and contribute technically to challenging EHS compliance, management systems, auditing, and compliance assurance projects and programs for clients locally, nationally, and internationally. What Your Impact Is Serve as project manager and deliver EHS compliance and management system projects that reduce risk and strengthen regulatory performance. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, shaping EHS strategy and driving long-term program success. Elevate EHS programs from compliance-driven to performance-oriented and sustainability-aligned. Build and expand client relationships, generating repeat business and contributing to regional growth. Mentor and develop talent, fostering a high-performing and collaborative team environment. What You'll Bring Required BS in engineering (chemical, mechanical, environmental), environmental science, or related degree, or equivalent experience. 4-6 years (7+ years preferred) of relevant multimedia EHS compliance and management systems, including consulting experience. Strong technical knowledge in EHS compliance areas (e.g., e-waste, hazardous waste, stormwater, wastewater, and/or EPCRA). Experience with assessing regulatory applicability of regulations; compliance reporting; and communicating with and working with regulatory agencies. Experience writing proposals and managing projects, budgets, and timelines with accountability for quality outcomes. Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives, delegate effectively, and mentor team members. Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. Positive outlook and collaborative approach. Ability to travel up to 25%. This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Preferred MS in engineering (chemical, mechanical, environmental), environmental science, or related degree. Professional certifications (e.g., PE, CSP, CHMM). Experience working with auditing compliance programs, including e-waste, waste, stormwater, wastewater, and/or EPCRA. Experience with developing, maintaining and/or auditing EHS management systems (ISO 14001 / ISO 45001, R2, RIOS, ISO 9001). Key Responsibilities Lead EHS compliance audits, assessments, and corrective action implementation across client operations. Develop and implement EHS management systems and regulatory programs (water, waste, spill prevention). Provide support for permit application development and regulatory agency communication. Provide on-site compliance support and technical expertise at client facilities. Manage multiple projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery within scope, schedule, and budget. Identify and develop new opportunities, prepare effective technical proposals, and take an active leadership role in developing new business with new and existing clients. As a project manager, work closely with clients and ERM teams to achieve client expectations for scope, budget, schedule, and quality. Build and maintain strong client relationships to drive repeat business and new opportunities. Prepare proposals, identify growth opportunities, and contribute to expanding ERM's EHS services. Mentor junior staff, delegate work effectively, and support team development and performance. Collaborate with ERM's global network to share best practices and deliver innovative solutions. Who We Are: As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations. At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career. title: Managing Technical Consultant, Remediation Construction and Demolition Manager
jd_text: Lead Complex Industrial Transformation Projects That Deliver Safer, More Sustainable Outcomes ERM is seeking a Managing Technical Consultant, Remediation Construction and Demolition Manager to join our team in Houston, Texas . title: Director, AI Governance & Enterprise Solutions
jd_text: Job Description Position Overview Reporting to the SVP, Software Engineering and AI Operations, the Director of AI Governance & Enterprise Solutions is Momentive's senior AI subject matter expert — the person who sets the technical bar for how the company designs, builds, deploys, and governs AI agents. This role owns the Momentive Context Library, defines and enforces the standards that all AI agents must meet, leads the review and approval of agents across the portfolio, and directly builds agents and skills for the AI Operations Hub. When business units need to build AI solutions, this leader will be a strategic technical partner. Core Responsibilities Context Library Ownership Own the Momentive Context Library — the shared knowledge repository that AI agents across the company depend on for accurate, consistent, organization-specific context. Define the library's architecture, taxonomy, and content standards, ensuring it is well-organized, current, and designed to be consumed reliably by agents across different use cases. Define and maintain the standards for centrally-owned content — shared company knowledge, cross-functional reference material, and foundational context that spans business units — ensuring it remains accurate, current, and consistently structured. Partner with AI Operations Hub spoke leads to help them build, structure, and maintain department-owned content — including converting existing documentation and institutional knowledge into library-ready context. Agent Review & Standards Define the technical review criteria and quality standards that all AI agents, skills, and connectors must meet for AI Operations Hub approval — covering design, architecture, data handling, accuracy, safety, and operational readiness. Lead the technical review and approval process for all AI agents submitted through the AI Operations Hub intake process, making or formally endorsing go/no-go recommendations. Develop agent development guidelines, design patterns, and templates that translate AI Operations Hub standards into practical, reusable building blocks for spoke teams. Identify systemic quality issues, common failure modes, and emerging risks across the agent portfolio, and use those insights to continuously raise the technical bar. Building for AI Operations Directly design and build AI agents, skills, and connectors for the AI Operations team's own use — including tooling that supports AI Operations Hub functions like intake review, registry management, and performance monitoring. Prototype and evaluate new agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, and tooling approaches before recommending them for broader organizational use. Technical Consulting & Deployment Guidance Serve as the primary technical advisor to spoke teams as they design and build AI solutions — providing hands-on architecture guidance, reviewing approach before build begins, and troubleshooting when things go wrong. Own the AI Operations Hub's standards for how agents are deployed, monitored, and secured in production — including environment configuration, observability requirements, access controls, and incident response protocols. Partner with Corporate IT on the platform and infrastructure decisions that affect how agents are deployed and maintained across the organization. Assess and recommend AI platforms, tools, and vendor solutions as the technology landscape evolves, with a focus on what will actually serve Momentive's operational model. Partner on how AI agents and automation intersect with the enterprise application portfolio — aligning platform strategy, tooling investments, and governance standards across both functions. Enablement Develop technical reference materials, design pattern libraries, and decision guides that help spoke teams make better architectural choices independently. Deliver targeted technical training and workshops when spoke teams need to build a foundational capability — this is a supporting function, not a primary one. Actively connect spoke teams to each other — surfacing shared use cases, reusable patterns, and prior work across business units so teams build on each other's progress instead of solving the same problems independently. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and building software or AI systems, with at least 3 years working directly with large language models, AI agents, and production AI deployments. Deep practical expertise with AI agent architectures, LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and the tradeoffs between them. Expert-level knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use and function calling, context window management, and agent evaluation methodologies. Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents in production environments — including decisions around deployment architecture, observability, access controls, and failure handling. Experience designing or governing shared knowledge repositories, context management systems, or information architectures for AI systems. Strong instincts for AI risk — understanding where agents fail, how to test for it, and how to build systems that degrade gracefully. Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, Azure OpenAI Service, Google Vertex AI, or similar. Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to make complex technical positions clear and defensible to both engineering and non-technical leadership audiences. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF or similar) and responsible AI principles as they apply to production systems. Experience operating in a cross-functional environment where you set standards others must follow, not just your own team. Demonstrated growth mindset and commitment to staying ahead in a rapidly evolving field. What Success Looks Like Every AI agent that reaches production has been reviewed against a clear, defensible technical standard — and the review process makes agents better, not just slower. The Momentive Context Library is the most trusted source of organizational knowledge available to AI agents — current, well-structured, and actively relied upon by spoke teams. AI Operations' own agents are high-quality, well-maintained, and set the standard that spoke teams aspire to. Spoke teams leave technical consultations with a clearer path forward and better architectural decisions than they would have made on their own. Production agents are deployed consistently, monitored reliably, and secured according to a clear, documented standard. title: Lead Wind Technician at Notrees Wind Farm
jd_text: Job Description: Overview Deriva Energy is a leading Independent Power Producer in the US renewables market, with over 6 GW of operating or under construction wind, solar and storage projects across the country. Incumbent functions in lead roles providing guidance to others. They are also expected to have advanced skills and have the ability to work independently. Perform operations, planned maintenance, and unplanned maintenance on sub-station equipment. Troubleshooting warranty issues Daily, weekly, monthly reporting needs Work as scheduled during the week and on call as needed or required by manager. Act as the backup to the active manager Assist management (as needed) with vendor contractual and activities, landowner agreements, and ensuring compliance with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations. Always maintain a high level of safety awareness Climb heights 300 ft. and greater several times daily Diagnose and resolve faults on turbines as they relate to mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic problems Perform troubleshooting to identify the root cause of an issue and perform corrective actions or open a service case with equipment manufacturer Perform energy isolation in accordance with all Lock Out / Tag Out Procedures Perform pad mounted Transformer switching in accordance with all Hazardous Energy Controls Procedures Perform small or large corrective tasks on wind turbines Perform preventative maintenance, corrective maintenance, performance monitoring and evaluation Maintaining all aspects (e.g., electrical, mechanical, civil, etc.) of turbines in a safe, high quality, and efficient manner Maintain EH&S Documentation and complete necessary paperwork (work order, timesheet, tool and PPE inventory, and additional paperwork as necessary) within Maximo Basic Qualifications High School/GED External Candidates - In addition to the High School/GED requirement, (6+) years of related work experience. Experience with Vestas turbines Experience with multiple wind turbine supplier technologies High voltage and substation maintenance experience Familiarity with mechanical and electronic testing equipment (i.e., voltage testers, amp clamps, oscilloscopes, and various hand and power tools) Knowledge of heavy equipment for facility maintenance and working knowledge of crane and rigging requirements Competent with Maximo EZ Max mobile work and My Time management systems Microsoft Office Including Excel/Word/PowerPoint CPR and AED Training Certification TSL tower climber and rescue & EEM training Forklift certified WORKING CONDITIONS Valid Driver’s License required Any travel to projects Exposure to mechanical, electrical, and/or other hazards Exposure to noisy, dusty conditions, chemicals, or solvents Operate equipment including but not limited to forklifts and commercial motor vehicles Ability to climb and work on turbine towers with heights up to 300 ft. daily Ability to lift 75lbs individually Walking, Climbing of stairs, ladders, and/or scaffolds Working in all-weather outdoor conditions (extreme heat, cold, wind, rain, snow) Completion of OEM or third-party technical specialty training program. title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer (Burnet, TX)
jd_text: Job Title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer (Burnet, TX) Job Description: The Role Entegris is currently seeking a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our Manufacturing Engineering team . This position will be based in our Burnet, TX facility. In this role, you will be a key player on a dynamic, skilled team whose objective is to sustain and continuously improve highly complex containers for specialty chemical products used in semiconductor manufacturing. Our specialty chemicals enable our customers to build high-performance semiconductor products. You will be primarily responsible for the engineering component of the container hardware work cell , supporting day-to-day operations . supporting data-driven operational planning, cross-functional leadership, process optimization, organizational improvement initiatives, and strategic decision-making through quantitative analysis of manufacturing performance, capacity utilization , quality metrics, and process effectiveness. What You’ll Do Lead continuous improvement projects both individually and in collaboration with cross functional team members following robust change control processes and using statistical data analysis to support qualification. Leverage statistical process control tools and methodology to identify both proactive and reactive opportunities for improvement; maintain effective internal control limits and work with customer teams on negotiating limits for key customers that provide quality assurance to customers while maintaining manufacturability for the factory. Support strategic business and operational improvements through data-driven analysis of manufacturing performance, capacity utilization , quality metrics, and process effectiveness. Complete failure analysis to identify root cause, develop and implement corrective/preventative actions along with material disposition to resolve both internal and external non-conformances; collaborate with customer teams on reporting findings and action closures, using 8D template when applicable. Utilize structured problem-solving tools such as 8D, 5 Why, RCA, Fishbone, etc. to drive to root cause and then resolution in a methodical fashion for both product and process defects or upsets. Maintain and improve key process documentation such as work instructions, FMEAs, and control plans and incorporate updates as new failure modes are identified or process changes are implemented; responsible for maintaining critical master data in ERP systems such as BOMs, routings, and material master information. Leverage capacity data to identify bottlenecks and candidates for capacity expansion projects and d evelop business cases and financial justifications for capital investments if required . E xecute capacity expansion projects to completion. Support production by troubleshooting equipment or process breakdowns, ensuring robust PM plans and critical spares are identified and stocked. Communicate effectively across the organization (e.g., marketing, R&D, facilities, operations, etc.) to drive a result; contribute to the direction of the department in partnership with other members of the team and leadership. Mentor personnel in problem-solving methodologies, data analysis, performance improvement, and process standardization. What We Seek Bachelors of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related field 5 + years of experience in manufacturing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of process equipment Experience with stainless steel hazardous material vessel design, valving, orbital welding a plus Understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) as well as statistical data analysis for application to Qualification and Validation. Experience with Minitab a plus. Demonstrated ability to lead structured problem solving using tools such as 8D, FMEA, 5 Why, RCA, etc Aptitude for leadership to drive cross-functional project execution and problem solving while maintaining positive/collaborative working relationships Ability to present technical data to all levels of the organization Ability to travel domestically and/or internationally in support of various engineering projects/escalations (<5%) Why Work at Entegris Lead. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. title: Commercial Strategy and Operations Manager

title: Manager Large Load Planning
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. This role manages the team responsible for ERCOT's Large Load planning and Batch studies, developing transmission system upgrade projects ranging from $50 million to over $1 billion while leading the Large Load Batch Zero process to identify near-term load allocation and recommend transmission projects addressing long-term reliability needs. The position oversees steady-state power flow contingency and congestion management analyses, structures planning studies to evaluate proposed projects, and is responsible for staff hiring, coaching, performance management, and departmental budget oversight. This role coordinates cross-functionally across Planning, Interconnection, and Network Modeling to align Large Load interconnection policy and study standards, and develops new transmission planning techniques, protocols, and procedures to meet evolving system and market needs. title: Release Train Engineer
jd_text: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. JOB SUMMARY Facilitate product release planning and governs the end-to-end release lifecycle across ERCOT applications, AI, and data platform portfolio. Coordinates release planning sessions, backlog management, and product roadmap facilitation across Agile sprint, waterfall, and hybrid delivery teams. Owns the production release calendar, NERC CIP change governance, ServiceNow change management workflows, and program-level delivery metrics reporting. Serves as the connective tissue between delivery teams, business stakeholders, and governance bodies — ensuring every release is planned, approved, measured, and continuously improved. JOB DUTIES Applies knowledge of release planning, change management, and delivery governance principles to facilitate structured, compliant, and predictable software releases across ERCOT's application and data platform portfolio. Follows established release management processes and procedures to coordinate deployment activities across Agile sprint, waterfall, and hybrid delivery teams; ensures cross-functional alignment on release scope, schedule, and readiness. Creates, reviews, and manages IT change records in ServiceNow in accordance with ERCOT change management standards; coordinates Change Advisory Board activities and ensures all releases meet NERC CIP change governance requirements prior to production promotion. Maintains the production release calendar and facilitates release planning meetings, backlog grooming sessions, and deployment readiness reviews to ensure consistent, predictable release cadence across all delivery tracks. Contributes to the generation and distribution of release metrics, status reports, and delivery dashboards supporting program-level visibility and continuous improvement of the release management function. ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES — BY LEVEL Level 2 — Release Train Engineer Release Planning Facilitation — Facilitate product release planning sessions across Agile sprint teams, waterfall project tracks, and hybrid delivery programs; coordinate cross-team capacity, feature scoping, dependency mapping, and risk identification for each planning cycle. Product Roadmap Facilitation — Facilitate product roadmap planning sessions with Product Managers, architects, and business stakeholders; maintain roadmap visibility in Jira; communicate how planned features and releases map to organizational priorities and delivery capacity. Waterfall Project Release Planning — Own release planning for waterfall project tracks: milestone definition, phase gate sequencing, Gantt-style schedule development, resource coordination, and formal release approval planning. Agile Sprint & Iteration Release Planning — Facilitate sprint and iteration release planning for Agile teams; coordinate sprint-to-release promotion sequencing, release branch readiness, and Definition of Done alignment across development, QA, and release engineering. Backlog Management & Grooming Facilitation — Facilitate product and program backlog grooming and refinement sessions; ensure epics, features, and stories are sufficiently defined, estimated, dependency-mapped, and ready for sprint or project execution. ServiceNow Change Record Management — Create, review, and manage change records in ServiceNow; ensure change classification, approval routing, and documentation meet ITSM governance and NERC CIP audit standards. Release Calendar Coordination — Maintain the production release calendar; coordinate deployment windows across delivery teams, infrastructure, and change management; communicate release schedule and risk to all stakeholders. Release Metrics & DORA Data Collection — Capture and report release frequency, change volume by type, change success rates, PI predictability, and sprint velocity; contribute to DORA and ITC metric dashboards in Power BI. CAB Meeting Facilitation — Facilitate Change Advisory Board meetings; prepare and distribute meeting agendas, capture decisions and action items, and ensure CAB notes are documented and distributed to stakeholders. Deployment Readiness Tracking — Track release deliverables, security compliance checks, and functional test approvals; confirm production readiness criteria are met before each deployment window. Stakeholder Communication — Coordinate release communication across development, QA, operations, and business teams; ensure all stakeholders have timely, accurate information on release scope, schedule, and risk. Documentation & Process Standards — Update and maintain release management process documentation, runbooks, and deployment checklists following applicable ERCOT standards. Sr. Release Train Engineer (All Level 2 duties plus:) Hybrid Delivery Coordination — Coordinate release planning and deployment sequencing across teams operating under Agile, waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies; synchronize cross-team releases when shared dependencies exist. Program-Level Release Governance — Enforce release readiness criteria before each deployment window; validate test completion evidence, environment stability, stakeholder approvals, and CAB authorization; serve as program-level production gate keeper. NERC CIP & ITSM Change Governance — Ensure all releases comply with NERC CIP change management requirements; coordinate with the CAB, enforce change classification standards, and maintain complete audit trails for all production promotions. Emergency & Expedited Change Coordination — Facilitate emergency and expedited change management processes; coordinate expedited CAB review, risk assessment documentation, stakeholder notification, and post-implementation review. IT & Change Metrics Reporting — Track and report IT change metrics including change volume by type, change success rate, unauthorized change incidents, CAB throughput, change-to-incident correlation, and SLA compliance; publish via ServiceNow and Power BI. SDLC Metrics & Delivery Throughput Analysis — Measure program-level SDLC metrics including throughput, cycle time, lead time, WIP load, and bottleneck patterns; publish actionable insights to delivery leadership. Release Health Dashboards — Design and maintain executive-facing dashboards in Power BI reflecting deployment status, release calendar adherence, milestone completion rates, change success rates, and DORA metric trends. Dependency & Risk Register Management — Maintain a product dependency map and risk register; facilitate cross-team dependency resolution and ensure all risks are visible, owned, and actively mitigated. Continuous Improvement Leadership — Lead retrospectives and release planning improvement sessions; identify and drive elimination of waste, handoff delays, and approval bottlenecks; track improvement items to completion. Waterfall Phase Gate & Milestone Governance — Coordinate formal waterfall phase gate reviews; ensure gate entry/exit criteria are met, required artifacts are complete, and stakeholder sign-offs are documented and archived TECHNOLOGY STACK All Release Train Engineer roles operate across the following technology stack. Depth of proficiency varies by level and role; senior levels are expected to demonstrate architectural and governance-level expertise across multiple categories. Senior Level: 5+ years in Release Management, Program Delivery, or Project Management with direct accountability for production release governance across Agile and waterfall methodologies. Lead Level: 8+ years in Release Management, Program Delivery, or Project Management with direct accountability for production release governance across Agile and waterfall methodologies.
